12V源下正上负，因此受控电流源上端电位为vR+12=14V。自行取其端电压上正下负，与向下电流构成关联方向，故吸收功率为正。The 12V source is positive at its lower terminal, placing the controlled-source upper terminal at vR+12=14V. Referencing its voltage positive at the top is passive with the downward current, so its absorbed power is positive.

ud=2+12=14V,pd,abs=udId=14W

受控电流源吸收14W。The controlled current source absorbs 14W.

易错点Common errors

  • 12V源的上端标“−”、下端标“+”，不能把受控源上端电位误写成vR−12。The 12V source is negative at its upper terminal and positive at its lower terminal; the controlled-source upper potential is vR+12.
  • 受控源是电源模型，但仍可能吸收功率；必须依据端电压与电流的共同参考方向判断。A controlled source can absorb power. Determine the sign from both its voltage and current references.

核验依据Verification

独立功率平衡：1、2、4Ω电阻分别耗散4、8、4W，3Ω电流为0；6V源吸收−18W，12V源吸收−12W，受控源吸收14W，总和16−18−12+14=0。书第332页、PDF341页1-30也给出14W、吸收功率。Independent power balance: the 1, 2 and 4Ω resistors dissipate 4, 8 and 4W; the 3Ω current is zero. The 6V and 12V sources absorb −18 and −12W, and the controlled source absorbs 14W: 16−18−12+14 = 0. Answer 1-30 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341 is also 14W absorbed.

1-31全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第35页／PDF第44页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

同节点识别：两只6Ω其实并联Recognize shared nodes: the two 6Ω resistors are parallel

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-29所示单口网络的等效电阻。Find the equivalent resistance of the one-port network in Fig. 1-29.

上端口A通过上方及右侧导线直接连到右中节点。竖6Ω与横6Ω都跨A和左中C；C经7Ω到底端口b；A另经右10Ω到底端口b。Upper port A is directly wired around the top and right to the right-middle node. Both vertical and horizontal 6Ω span A and left-middle C. C connects through 7Ω to lower port b; A also connects directly through right 10Ω to b.

本题图在书第35页／PDF第44页。The source figure is on printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想导线等电位；并联端点判定；串并联等效；测试源法。Equipotential ideal wires, endpoint-based parallel recognition, series and parallel reduction and test sources.
不要按图形位置判断串联。先把上方绕到右侧的整段导线认作同一节点，就能看出两只6Ω并联，随后与7Ω串联，再与10Ω并联。Do not infer series connection from placement. Trace the top and right wire as one node: the 6Ω pair is parallel, then series with 7Ω, and that path is parallel with 10Ω.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

化简两个6ΩCombine the two 6Ω resistors

两只6Ω的两端分别是同一A、C节点，因此并联为3Ω。Both 6Ω resistors share endpoints A and C, so their parallel equivalent is 3Ω.

6∥6=6·66+6=3Ω

完成串并联Finish the reduction

3Ω与7Ω串联为10Ω；这条支路与右10Ω并联，总等效5Ω。3Ω and 7Ω form a10Ω series path, parallel with the right 10Ω, giving 5Ω.

Req=[(6∥6)+7]∥10=10∥10=5Ω

Req=5Ω。Req=5Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 横6Ω右端与顶端口通过导线直接相连，不是新节点。The horizontal 6Ω right terminal is directly wired to the top port; it is not a new node.
  • 两只6Ω不是串联，因为公共节点还有7Ω分支。The 6Ω resistors are not series; their shared middle node also connects to 7Ω.

核验依据Verification

独立1V测试源原拓扑MNA得C=0.7V；两只6Ω各流0.05A，右10Ω流0.1A，总输入0.2A，R=10.2=5Ω。四电阻功率0.015+0.015+0.07+0.1=0.2W，等于测试端输入功率。附录第332页、PDF341页为5Ω。Independent original-topology MNA with a1V test gives C=0.7V, 0.05A in each 6Ω and 0.1A in right 10Ω. Input is 0.2A, so R=5Ω. Resistor powers 0.015+0.015+0.07+0.1=0.2W match port input power. The appendix on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341 gives 5Ω.

1-32指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第35页／PDF第44页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：1-32Assigned requirement: 1-32

交叉线不相连：开关前后的等效电阻Unconnected crossing wires: resistance before and after switching

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-30所示单口网络分别在开关S打开和闭合时的等效电阻。Find the equivalent resistance of the one-port network in Fig. 1-30 with switch S open and with S closed.

a在左上，b在左下，右上与右下两节点由开关S连接。a到右上为36Ω，a到右下斜支路也为36Ω；b到右下为24Ω，b到右上斜支路也为24Ω。两条斜线在中央交叉处无连接点，互不连接。Terminal a is upper left and b lower left. Switch S connects the upper-right and lower-right nodes. There are 36Ω from a to each right node and 24Ω from b to each right node. The crossing diagonal wires have no junction and are not connected.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

按节点判断串并联；无连接点的交叉线。Series and parallel reduction by nodes and unconnected wire crossings.
先按导线连接关系重画，不能把中央交叉当节点。开关打开时是两条独立串联支路，闭合时是两组并联电阻串联。Redraw by connectivity, keeping the central crossing disconnected. With S open there are two series paths in parallel; with S closed, two parallel groups are in series.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

开关打开Switch open

a经任一右侧节点到b都必须依次经过36Ω和24Ω，每条路径60Ω；两条路径只在a、b端相接。Each a−to−b path through a right node contains 36Ω and 24Ω in series, making 60Ω. The two paths meet only at a and b.

Ropen=(36+24)∥(36+24)=30Ω

开关闭合Switch closed

两个右侧节点被短接合并。a到该公共节点有两个36Ω并联，b到该节点有两个24Ω并联，再将两组串联。The two right nodes merge. The two 36Ω resistors from a are parallel, as are the two 24Ω resistors from b. These groups are then in series.

Rclosed=(36∥36)+(24∥24)=18+12=30Ω

解释为何数值相同Explain the unchanged value

原来两条路径具有相同分压比例，所以右侧两个节点本来等电位。连接等电位节点不会改变端口电流。The two original paths have identical divider ratios, so the right nodes are already at equal potentials. Connecting them does not change terminal current.

S打开：30Ω；S闭合：30Ω。S open: 30Ω. S closed: 30Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 中央导线交叉无黑点，不可自行增加连接。开关闭合也不等于把整个端口短路。Do not add a connection at the unmarked central crossing. Closing S does not short the entire port.

核验依据Verification

独立1V测试：令Va=1V、Vb=0，开关打开时两个右侧节点均为24(36+24)=0.4V；总测试电流为2×(1−0.4)36=130A，故Req=30Ω。等电位使闭合时开关电流为0，结果仍30Ω。书第332页、PDF341页1-32为30Ω、30Ω。Independent 1V test: with Va=1V and Vb=0, both right nodes are at 24(36+24)=0.4V. Total test current is 2(1−0.4)36=130A, giving 30Ω. The closed switch carries zero current between equal potentials, preserving 30Ω. Answer 1-32 on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341 gives 30Ω in both cases.

1-33全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第35页／PDF第44页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

两层分流：先分主支路，再分子支路Two-level current division: main branches, then subbranches

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-31所示电路中的电流ix和iᵧ。Find ix and iᵧ in Fig. 1-31.

12A源向上接顶底公共节点。左支路3Ω串联4Ω与12Ω并联，ix在左4Ω向下；右支路12Ω与6Ω并联后串联底6Ω，iᵧ在底6Ω向下。An upward 12A source feeds common top and bottom nodes. Left branch: 3Ω in series with parallel 4Ω and 12Ω, with ix downward in 4Ω. Right branch: parallel 12Ω and 6Ω in series with lower 6Ω, with iᵧ downward through the lower 6Ω.

本题图在书第35页／PDF第44页。The source figure is on printed p. 35 · PDF p. 44.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

串并联电阻；分流公式；并联共电压；两次KCL。Series and parallel resistance, current division, common parallel voltage and two levels of KCL.
先把左右主支路化成6Ω和10Ω，分配总12A。iᵧ就是右主支路电流；ix还需在左4Ω与12Ω之间再分一次。First reduce the main branches to 6Ω and 10Ω and divide 12A. iᵧ is the right main current; ix requires another split within the left 4Ω12Ω pair.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求左右主支路电阻Reduce the main branches

左侧4∥12=3Ω，与顶3Ω串联为6Ω；右侧12∥6=4Ω，与底6Ω串联为10Ω。Left: 4∥12=3Ω plus upper 3Ω gives 6Ω. Right: 12∥6=4Ω plus lower 6Ω gives 10Ω.

RL=3+(4∥12)=6,RR=(12∥6)+6=10(Ω)

第一次分流Divide the main current

左主支路IL=12×10(6+10)=7.5A；右主支路iᵧ=12×6(6+10)=4.5A。The left main current is 12×1016=7.5A, and iᵧ is 12×616=4.5A.

IL=152A,iy=92A

第二次分流求ixDivide again for ix

左7.5A进入4Ω与12Ω并联，4Ω得到IL×12(4+12)=5.625A。The left 7.5A enters parallel 4Ω and 12Ω, so ix=IL×1216=5.625A.

ix=152·1216=458=5.625A

ix=5.625A，iᵧ=4.5A，均按图向下。ix=5.625A and iᵧ =4.5A, both downward as drawn.

易错点Common errors

  • 左主支路7.5A还要分流，不能直接当ix。The left main 7.5A splits again; it is not ix.
  • 分流与电阻成反比，4Ω获得的电流大于12Ω。Current divides inversely with resistance; 4Ω takes more than 12Ω.

核验依据Verification

独立原六电阻节点MNA得顶节点45V、左中22.5V、右中27V；ix=22.54=458A，iᵧ=276=92A。总电阻耗散540W，恰等于12A源提供45×12=540W。附录第332页、PDF341页两项一致。Independent MNA of all six original resistors gives top 45V, left middle 22.5V and right middle 27V, yielding ix=458A and iᵧ =92A. Dissipation is 540W, matching the source’s45×12=540W. Both values match the appendix on printed p. 332 and PDF p. 341.

1-34全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第36页／PDF第45页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

反求未知电阻：分清并联分流和串联分压Recover unknown resistance: parallel current and series voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-32所示各电路中的电阻R。 (1) 图(a)电路中i=23A；(2) 图(b)电路中i=23A； (3) 图(c)电路中u=23V；(4) 图(d)电路中u=23V。Find R in each circuit of Fig. 1-32. (1) In (a), i=23A; (2) in (b), i=23A; (3) in (c), u=23V; (4) in (d), u=23V.

(a)3A总电流注入2Ω与R并联，i在R向下。(b)同样并联但总端电压3V。(c)3A通过串联R、2Ω，u跨R上正下负。(d)同样串联但总电压3V，u仍跨R。(a)3A enters parallel 2Ω and R, with i downward in R. (b) The parallel pair has 3V across it. (c)3A flows through series R and 2Ω, with u positive at the top of R. (d) The series pair has total 3V, again with u across R.

本题图在书第36页／PDF第45页。The source figure is on printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

KCL；并联共电压；串联同电流；欧姆定律；精确分数。KCL, common parallel voltage, equal series current, Ohm’s law and exact fractions.
先判断每幅图给的是总电流还是总电压，测的是R支路电流还是R两端电压。四问不共享一个R，必须分别求。Identify whether each panel gives total current or voltage and whether the measurement is R current or voltage. The four R values are independent.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(1) 并联给总电流(1): parallel pair with known total current

2Ω电流为3−23=73A，所以并联电压143V，R=(143)(23)=7Ω。The 2Ω current is 73A, giving common voltage 143V and R=7Ω.

R(a)=2(3−23)23=7Ω

(2) 并联给端电压(2): parallel pair with known voltage

R直接承受3V，电流23A，因此R=3(23)=4.5Ω。R directly has 3V with 23A, so R=4.5Ω.

R(b)=323=92Ω

(3) 串联给总电流(3): series pair with known current

R流过3A，压降23V，因此R=(23)3=29Ω。R carries 3A and drops 23V, so R=29Ω.

R(c)=233=29Ω≈0.2222Ω

(4) 串联给总电压(4): series pair with known total voltage

2Ω压降为3−23=73V，串联电流为76A。R=(23)(76)=47Ω。The 2Ω drop is 73V and the series current 76A, giving R=47Ω.

R(d)=23(3−23)2=47Ω≈0.5714Ω

(1)7Ω；(2)92Ω=4.5Ω；(3)29Ω≈0.2222Ω；(4)47Ω≈0.5714Ω。(1)7Ω; (2)92Ω=4.5Ω; (3)29Ω≈0.2222Ω; (4)47Ω≈0.5714Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • (a)的3A是总电流，不能当R支路电流。The 3A in (a) is total current, not the R−branch current.
  • (d)的u只跨R，不能把总3V直接当u。In (d), u is across R only, not the total 3V.
  • 先保留29、47等精确值，最后再按题目需要舍入。Retain exact fractions such as 29 and 47 until final rounding.

核验依据Verification

四个原拓扑分别恢复所得R，并用3A测试注入或3V源独立MNA：两并联问的R电流均严格23A，两串联问的R压降均严格23V；每问全部元件功率相加精确为0。附录第333页、PDF342页为7、4.5、0.22、0.57Ω，后两值是精确分数的舍入。Independent original-topology MNA restores each R using either 3A injection or a3V source. Both parallel R currents are exactly 23A; both series R drops are exactly 23V, and full power balances vanish. The appendix on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 gives 7, 4.5, 0.22 and 0.57Ω, with the latter two rounded from the exact fractions.

1-35全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第36页／PDF第45页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

非直接串并联网络：用Δ−Y化简并以测试源复核A non-series-parallel network: Δ−Y and a test-source audit

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-33所示电路ab端口的等效电阻。Find the equivalent resistance at port ab of Fig. 1-33.

上顶点A为端口a，内中心C为端口b，外左L、外右D。六电阻：A−L为2Ω，A−C为2Ω，A−D为4Ω，L−C为2Ω，D−C为2Ω，L−D为4Ω。从C向右的b引线与A−D斜边交叉处没有连接点。Top A is port a and center C port b; outer vertices are L and D. Resistors: A−L2Ω, A−C2Ω, A−D4Ω, L−C2Ω, D−C2Ω and L−D4Ω. The b lead crossing the A−D diagonal has no junction dot.

本题图在书第36页／PDF第45页。The source figure is on printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

按节点识别连接；Δ−Y变换；串并联；端口1V测试源与节点法。Node-based connectivity, Δ−Y transformation, series and parallel reduction and a1V port test.
不能按图中交叉线虚构连接点。外圈是2、4、4Ω三角形，转成星形后可直接串并联；最后用完整六电阻节点法独立核验。Do not create a node at an unmarked crossing. Transform the outer 2–4–4Ω triangle into a star, reduce the result, then independently check the original six-resistor graph.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

外三角形Δ→YTransform the outer triangle to a star

外三角形边A−L=2、A−D=4、L−D=4Ω，总和10Ω。新增星点O，三臂分别A−O=0.8、L−O=0.8、D−O=1.6Ω。The outer triangle has edges 2, 4 and 4Ω, totaling 10Ω. With star center O, its A, L and D arms are 0.8, 0.8 and 1.6Ω.

RAO=2·410=45,RLO=2·410=45,RDO=4·410=85(Ω)

O到b的两条路径并联Combine the two O−to−b paths

O−L−b为0.8+2=145Ω；O−D−b为1.6+2=185Ω。并联得到6340Ω，再与A−O的45Ω串联得198Ω。O−L−b is 145Ω and O−D−b is 185Ω. In parallel they give 6340Ω; adding A−O=45Ω yields an A−to−b path of 198Ω.

ROC=145∥185=6340,RAOC=45+6340=198(Ω)

与直接2Ω支路并联Combine with the direct 2Ω branch

原有A−C的2Ω仍在，最终与198Ω并联。The original A−C2Ω remains and is parallel with 198Ω.

Rab=2∥198=3835Ω≈1.085714Ω

Rab=3835Ω≈1.085714Ω；按一位小数为1.1Ω。Rab=3835Ω≈1.085714Ω, or 1.1Ω to one decimal place.

易错点Common errors

  • b引线跨过外斜边但没有连接点，不可将外右4Ω短接。The b lead crosses an outer edge without a junction; do not short the outer 4Ω.
  • 原图不是直接串并联网络，两个相邻2Ω不能不看分支就相加。The original graph is not directly series-parallel; adjacent 2Ω resistors cannot be combined without checking branches.

核验依据Verification

独立在原六电阻网络a−b加1V，以b=0。精确节点法得VL=919、VD=719V，端口电流3538A，R=3835Ω，与Δ−Y结果完全相同；全部电阻功率之和等于3538W端口输入。附录第333页、PDF342页的1.1Ω为一位小数舍入。An independent 1V test on the original six-resistor network with b=0 gives VL=919 and VD=719V by exact nodal analysis. Port current is 3538A, giving R=3835Ω, exactly matching Δ−Y. Total dissipation equals port input 3538W. The appendix’s1.1Ω on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 is rounded to one decimal place.

1-36全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第36页／PDF第45页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

桥接电阻网络：先求输入电阻再求源电流A bridged resistor network: recover its input resistance

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-34所示电路中的电流i。Find current i in Fig. 1-34.

10V源上正下负，顶端经2Ω到T，i向右。T经1Ω到C、C经4Ω到底左地节点；T经右4Ω到D、D经底4Ω到地；C、D间有8Ω。A top-positive 10V source connects through top 2Ω to T, with i rightward. T connects through 1Ω to C and C through 4Ω to ground; T through right 4Ω to D and D through bottom 4Ω to ground; C and D are joined by 8Ω.

本题图在书第36页／PDF第45页。The source figure is on printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

桥接网络节点法；同节点判定；输入电阻测试；串联总电阻。Nodal analysis of a bridge, shared-node identification, input-resistance tests and series total resistance.
中间4Ω与8Ω的下端不是同一节点，不能直接并联。先把顶端2Ω以右的桥网络作为一端口，用任意端电压v求其输入电流，再得到等效3Ω。The lower ends of the central 4Ω and 8Ω are different nodes, so they are not parallel. Apply arbitrary voltage v to the network after the top 2Ω and find its input current; its equivalent is 3Ω.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

桥网络节点方程Write the bridge-node equations

令T电位为v、底部0。C点：(VC−v)1+VC4+(VC−VD)8=0；D点：(VD−v)4+VD4+(VD−VC)8=0。Set T to v and bottom to zero. KCL at C and D yields the two equations shown.

11VC−VD=8v,−VC+5VD=2v

求桥网络等效电阻Find the bridge input resistance

解得VC=7v9、VD=5v9。输入电流为(v−VC)1+(v−VD)4=v3，因此桥网络等效3Ω。Solving gives VC=7v9 and VD=5v9. Input current is (v−VC)1+(v−VD)4=v3, so the bridge equivalent is 3Ω.

Ibridge=v−7v91+v−5v94=v3,Rbridge=3Ω

加顶端2Ω求iInclude the top 2Ω to obtain i

10V源看到2+3=5Ω，因此i=105=2A，按图向右。The 10V source sees 2+3=5Ω, so i=2A rightward.

i=102+3=2A

i=2A，按原图向右。i=2A, rightward as drawn.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能将中央4Ω和8Ω直接并联，它们底端之间还有4Ω。The central 4Ω and 8Ω are not parallel; a4Ω separates their lower nodes.
  • 该桥的14和44不成比例，不能擅自令8Ω无电流。Bridge ratios 14 and 44 do not match; do not assume zero current in 8Ω.

核验依据Verification

独立原六电阻MNA恢复10V源，解得T=6V、C=143V、D=103V，顶2Ω电流2A；8Ω电流16A，确非0。源提供20W，六电阻总耗散20W，全部节点残差精确为0。与附录第333页、PDF342页2A一致。Independent MNA of all six original resistors with 10V gives T=6V, C=143V and D=103V, hence 2A through the top resistor. The 8Ω current is 16A, not zero. The source supplies 20W and all resistors dissipate 20W, with exact nodal residuals. This matches 2A in the appendix on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342.

1-37全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第36页／PDF第45页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

电流源功率：不能漏掉串联电阻的端电压Current-source power: include its series resistor drop

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-35所示电路中电流源提供的功率。Find the power supplied by the current source in Fig. 1-35.

左支路上2Ω、下2Ω，中点L；右内支路上1Ω、下1Ω，中点M；外右1Ω跨顶T与底0。中横支路5A源由L向右到X，再经2Ω到M。Left vertical branch has 2Ω above and below midpoint L; inner-right branch has 1Ω above and below M; outer-right 1Ω spans top T and bottom 0. The middle branch has a5A source from L to X, then 2Ω from X to M.

本题图在书第36页／PDF第45页。The source figure is on printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

节点法；电流源串联支路电流固定；源端电压；提供功率为−p吸收。Nodal analysis, fixed current in a current-source series branch, source terminal voltage and supplied power = −absorbed power.
5A经中间2Ω流向M，其源右端X比M高10V。要计算电流源功率，必须求L与X之间电压，不能仅用L与M之间电压。The 5A through middle 2Ω makes source terminal X10V above M. Source power needs the L−to−X voltage, not just L−to−M.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求三个主要节点电位Find the three main node potentials

底部设0。L点KCL给2VL−VT=−10；M点给2VM−VT=5；T点给5VT−VL−2VM=0。解得VT=0、VL=−5、VM=2.5V。With bottom zero, KCL gives 2VL−VT=−10, 2VM−VT=5 and 5VT−VL−2VM=0. Thus VT=0, VL=−5 and VM=2.5V.

VT=0,VL=−5,VM=52(V)

加上中间2Ω压降Include the middle 2Ω drop

中间2Ω流过5A，X到M降10V，因此VX=2.5+10=12.5V。Middle 2Ω carries 5A and drops 10V from X to M, so VX=12.5V.

VX=VM+5(2)=12.5V

计算提供功率Compute supplied power

源电流从L向X，沿电流电位升高12.5−(−5)=17.5V。吸收功率(VL−VX)×5=−87.5W，提供87.5W。Current runs from L to X through a17.5V rise. Absorbed power is (VL−VX)×5=−87.5W, so supplied power is 87.5W.

PI,supplied=5(VX−VL)=87.5W

5A电流源提供87.5W。The 5A current source supplies 87.5W.

易错点Common errors

  • 中间2Ω与电流源串联，源端X和右中M不是同一节点。Source terminal X and right-middle M are separated by the series 2Ω.
  • VT=0是解方程的结果，不是顶底导线直接短接。VT=0 is a solved result, not a physical short between top and bottom.

核验依据Verification

独立保留源与中间2Ω之间节点X的完整MNA，得到T=0、L=−5、M=2.5、X=12.5V。六电阻耗散分别12.5、12.5、6.25、6.25、0、50W，总87.5W；电流源吸收−87.5W，功率和0。与附录第333页、PDF342页87.5W一致。Independent full MNA retains X between source and series resistor and gives T=0, L=−5, M=2.5 and X=12.5V. Resistor powers 12.5, 12.5, 6.25, 6.25, 0 and 50W total 87.5W; source absorption is −87.5W, balancing power. This matches 87.5W in the appendix on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342.

1-38全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第36页／PDF第45页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

无限梯形电路：自相似方程与正根Infinite ladder: self-similarity and the positive root

题目原文Transcribed question

题图1-36所示电路为具有无限多级的梯形电路，求输入端a、b之间的等效电阻Rab。Fig. 1-36 is an infinite ladder. Find the equivalent resistance Rab between input a and b.

从a先串联R到c，c经竖R到底导线b；c向右又串联R并在下一节点经R到底，逐级无限重复。底部为公共返回线，所有电阻均为正值R。From a, series R leads to c, where shunt R connects to common bottom b. The series-R and shunt−R pattern repeats infinitely to the right. All resistors have positive value R.

本题图在书第36页／PDF第45页。The source figure is on printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

串并联；无限网络自相似；二次方程；无源网络电阻非负；有限截断收敛。Series and parallel reduction, infinite self-similarity, a quadratic, passive nonnegative resistance and convergence of finite truncations.
从第一段串联R后看，当前竖R与右侧剩余无限梯形并联；右侧剩余网络与整个输入网络同形。令整体为x，即可建立一个标量方程。After the first series R, the local shunt R is parallel with an unchanged copy of the remaining infinite ladder. Calling the full resistance x gives one scalar equation.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

写自相似关系Write the self-similarity relation

整个输入等效x等于第一只串联R，加上当前竖R与同形剩余网络x的并联。The full x equals the first series R plus the parallel combination of the local shunt R and remaining copy x.

x=R+(R∥x)=R+RxR+x

解二次方程Solve the quadratic

整理为x2−Rx−R2=0，得到x=[(1±5)2]R。Rearrangement gives x2−Rx−R2=0, with roots [(1±5)2]R.

x2−Rx−R2=0⇒x=1±52R

用无源性选择正根Select the passive positive root

所有电阻为正，等效电阻必须为正，所以舍弃负根，Rab=(1+5)R2≈1.618034R。Every resistor is positive, so the equivalent must be positive. Reject the negative root and retain Rab=(1+5)R2.

Rab=1+52R≈1.618034R

Rab=(1+5)R2≈1.618034R，按两位小数为1.62R。Rab=(1+5)R2≈1.618034R, or 1.62R to two decimals.

易错点Common errors

  • 自相似剩余网络已含它自己的第一只串联R，不要重复加一只。The remaining copy already includes its own first series R; do not count it twice.
  • 二次方程的负根不适用于全正电阻无源网络。The negative root cannot represent this all-positive passive network.

核验依据Verification

独立搭建20级原梯形网络并加1V测试源，以有理数MNA求其输入电阻；同时从末端短路、开路截断生成精确下界、上界。上界与20级MNA完全一致，界宽约1.55×10−16R，夹住(1+5)R2；有限网络各节点及功率残差精确为0。附录第333页、PDF342页1.62R为两位小数舍入。An independently stamped 20-stage ladder with a1V test is solved by exact rational MNA. Short and open terminal truncations provide exact lower and upper bounds. The upper bound exactly matches the finite MNA result; the gap is about 1.55×10−16R and encloses (1+5)R2. All finite-network node and power residuals vanish. The appendix’s1.62R on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 is rounded to two decimals.

1-39全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第36页／PDF第45页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

含受控源的输入电阻：允许负值并保留受控源Input resistance with a dependent source: negative is possible

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-37所示单口网络的输入电阻。Find the input resistance of the one-port network in Fig. 1-37.

端口电压u上正下负，输入电流i从上端向右流入节点A。A经5Ω到底，并经顶3Ω到右节点B；右受控电流源2u从底向上流入B。Port u is positive at the top and i enters rightward into A. A connects through 5Ω to bottom and through top 3Ω to B. A dependent current source 2u runs upward from bottom into B.

本题图在书第36页／PDF第45页。The source figure is on printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

受控源不置零；测试源求ui；节点KCL；负输入电阻的有源意义。Keep dependent sources active, use a test source for ui, nodal KCL and the active meaning of negative input resistance.
用端口电压u控制原受控源，求输入电流i。受控源能够向端口供能，所以输入电阻不必为正；负值应由方程与功率共同确认。Use port voltage u to control the original source and solve input i. A dependent source can deliver energy at the port, so input resistance need not be positive; confirm a negative result by equations and power.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

右节点KCL求VBUse right-node KCL for VB

受控源向B注入2u，全部经3Ω流向A。因此(VB−u)3=2u，得VB=7u。The source injects 2u into B, all returning through 3Ω to A. Thus (VB−u)3=2u and VB=7u.

VB−u3=2u⇒VB=7u

求端口输入电流Find port input current

A流向5Ω的电流u5，加上A流向B电流(u−7u)3，得到i=−9u5。Add current u5 from A to ground and (u−7u)3 from A to B to obtain i=−9u5.

i=u5+u−7u3=−95u

求输入电阻并解释符号Find input resistance and interpret the sign

按流入端口正端的参考方向，Rin=ui=−59Ω。u>0时i<0，网络向外送电，符合有源受控网络的行为。With current referenced into the positive port, Rin=ui=−59Ω. For u>0, i<0, so the network delivers power outward, as an active controlled network can.

Rin=−59Ω

Rin=−59Ω≈−0.5556Ω。Rin=−59Ω≈−0.5556Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 求输入电阻时保留受控源及u控制关系，不能把它开路。Keep the dependent source and its u control active; do not open it.
  • 无源电阻仍耗能，负输入电阻的能量来自受控源。The ordinary resistors still dissipate energy; the dependent source supplies the negative port resistance’s energy.

核验依据Verification

独立1V端口测试原VCCSMNA得A=1、B=7V，输入i=−1.8A，R=−59Ω。5Ω和3Ω共耗散12.2W，受控源提供14W，余1.8W由网络送入测试电压源，全部功率和0。与附录第333页、PDF342页−59Ω一致。Independent original−VCCSMNA with a1V port test gives A=1V, B=7V and i=−1.8A, hence R=−59Ω. The resistors dissipate 12.2W and dependent source supplies 14W, leaving 1.8W delivered to the test voltage source. All powers balance. This matches −59Ω in the appendix on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342.

1-40全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第36页／PDF第45页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

受输入电流控制的源：先做节点KCL再求端电压A source controlled by input current: KCL before port voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图1-38所示单口网络的输入电阻。Find the input resistance of the one-port network in Fig. 1-38.

输入电流i由上端向右，经8Ω到节点B。B经3Ω到底，另有受控电流源3i由B向下到底。端口电压u上正下负。Input i enters rightward through 8Ω to B. B connects through 3Ω to bottom and through dependent current 3i directed downward. Port u is top-positive.

本题图在书第36页／PDF第45页。The source figure is on printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

受控源关系；KCL分流；输入串联压降；测试源法。Dependent-current law, KCL current splitting, input series drop and test sources.
8Ω流过的就是控制电流i，但3Ω不流i：受控源向下取3i，迫使3Ω的参考向下电流为−2i。求出B电位后再加8Ω压降。The 8Ω current is the control i, but the 3Ω current is not i. The dependent source takes 3i downward, forcing the 3Ω downward-reference current to −2i. Find B, then add the 8Ω drop.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

右节点KCL确定3Ω电流Use B−node KCL for the 3Ω current

节点B流入i，流出i3及3i，所以i3=i−3i=−2i，VB=3i3=−6i。At B, i enters and i3 plus 3i leave, so i3=−2i and VB=3i3=−6i.

i3=i−3i=−2i,VB=−6i

恢复端口电压Recover port voltage

从端口到B经8Ω压降8i，因此u=8i+VB=2i。The 8Ω drops 8i from port to B, so u=8i+VB=2i.

u=8i−6i=2i⇒Rin=ui=2Ω

Rin=2Ω。Rin=2Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 8Ω与3Ω不串联，因为它们之间节点还有受控源支路。8Ω and 3Ω are not series; their junction also connects the dependent source.
  • 控制量是流入端口的i，不能误用3Ω中的−2i去控制3i源。The control is input i, not the −2i current in 3Ω.

核验依据Verification

独立在输入支路放零伏电流传感器，按流入端口方向控制向下3i，并施加1V测试源。精确MNA得i=0.5A、B=−3V、受控源1.5A向下，故R=2Ω。电阻共耗散5W，受控源提供4.5W，端口输入0.5W，功率平衡。附录第333页、PDF342页为2Ω。Independent MNA inserts a zero-volt input-current sensor with the original inward reference to control downward 3i, then applies 1V. It gives i=0.5A, B=−3V and dependent current 1.5A downward, hence R=2Ω. Resistors dissipate 5W, the controlled source supplies 4.5W and the port supplies 0.5W, balancing power. The appendix on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 gives 2Ω.

1-41全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第36页／PDF第45页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

端口电压：沿源极性相加，优先识别直接并联Port voltage: source polarities and direct parallel constraints

题目原文Transcribed question

写出题图1-39所示各电路的端口电压u与各独立电源参数的关系。Express port voltage u in terms of the independent source parameters for each circuit in Fig. 1-39.

(a)上u1源上正下负，下u2源上负下正，两源串联；端口u上正下负。(b)u1直接跨端口，上正下负；左u2也上正下负，其上端经向左i1源接端口上端。(a) Series voltage sources: u1 top-positive, u2 bottom-positive; port u top-positive. (b)u1 is directly across the port with the same polarity. Left u2 is top-positive and its upper node connects through leftward i1 to the upper port.

本题图在书第36页／PDF第45页。The source figure is on printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

电压源端电压约束；串联电压代数和；并联同压；不以书后答案覆盖原图。Ideal voltage constraints, signed series sums, equal parallel voltage and checking the original figure.
(a)按端口从下到上累加电压升降。(b)先看直接并联端口的理想电压源，它固定u，左侧支路只影响内部电流。For (a), sum voltage rises from lower to upper port. For (b), the ideal source directly across the port fixes u; the left branch affects internal currents.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a) 串联反向电压(a): opposed series voltages

从下端向上先经过u2的正端到负端，电位降低u2；再经过u1的负端到正端，升高u1，因此u=u1−u2。Moving upward crosses u2 from positive to negative, then u1 from negative to positive, giving u=u1−u2.

u(a)=u1−u2

(b) 直接并联定端电压(b): direct parallel source

端口u和u1源都上正下负，且端点由导线直接相连，所以u=u1，与u2、i1无关。Port u and source u1 share both nodes and are both top-positive, so u=u1, independent of u2 and i1.

u(b)=u1

核对附录符号Check the appendix sign

附录第333页把(b)印成−u1，但原图端口与u1的极性相同，没有反向；该负号不应照抄。The appendix prints −u1 for (b), but the original port and u1 have identical polarity. That minus sign conflicts with the diagram.

(a)u=u1−u2；(b)u=u1。附录(b)的负号错误。(a)u=u1−u2; (b)u=u1. The appendix’s minus sign in (b) is incorrect.

易错点Common errors

  • 串联源要按正负端相加，不能把两个源幅值一律相加。Sum series sources by their polarities, not magnitudes alone.
  • 并联源与端口同极性时直接相等，不会因另一支路电流方向改变符号。A same-polarity parallel source equals the port voltage regardless of another branch’s current direction.

核验依据Verification

独立原图MNA在3组有正有负的源参数、每组3个负载下核验两图，分别恒得u1−u2及u1，全部节点及功率残差为0。(b)取u1=7V时端口为+7V，直接反证附录−7V。原图PDF45与附录PDF342高分辨率证据均保留。Independent original-topology MNA uses three source-parameter sets, including negative values, and three loads per set. The two results remain u1−u2 and u1 with zero node and power residuals. In (b), u1=7V gives +7V at the port, directly contradicting −7V. High-resolution original PDF45 and appendix PDF342 evidence is retained.

1-42全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第36页／PDF第45页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

端口电流：对整个两端网络列KCLPort current: apply KCL to the whole two-terminal network

题目原文Transcribed question

写出题图1-40所示各电路的端口电流i与各独立电源参数的关系。Express port current i in terms of the independent source parameters for each circuit in Fig. 1-40.

(a)左i2向上并联u1电压源，内部下节点经向右i1源接下端口；上端口电流i向右流出。(b)并联i1向上、i2向下，端口i从上端向右流出。(a) Upward i2 is parallel with u1. The lower internal node connects through rightward i1 to the lower port; upper-port i is outward. (b) Parallel i1 upward and i2 downward feed outward upper-port i.

本题图在书第36页／PDF第45页。The source figure is on printed p. 36 · PDF p. 45.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

两端口边界KCL；参考方向；电流源串并联约束。Boundary KCL, reference directions and ideal current-source constraints.
(a)上下端的外流参考箭头同为从内部流向外部，故代数和为0。(b)按上节点净注入相减。In (a), both terminal reference arrows point outward from the internal network, so their sum is zero. In (b), subtract the downward source from the upward injection.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a) 端口边界守恒(a): boundary current conservation

上端流出i，下端流出i1，整个两端网络不积累净电荷，故i+i1=0。内部u1、i2只调整内部支路量。Upper current i and lower current i1 both leave, so i+i1=0. Internal u1 and i2 only affect internal branch quantities.

i(a)=−i1

(b) 上节点KCL(b): upper-node KCL

i1从下流入顶节点，i2向下流出，剩余经端口流出的电流i=i1−i2。i1 enters the upper node and i2 leaves downward; the remaining outward port current is i1−i2.

i(b)=i1−i2

(a)i=−i1；(b)i=i1−i2。(a)i=−i1; (b)i=i1−i2.

易错点Common errors

  • (a)的i1箭头朝下端口外侧，不是从负端流入网络。In (a), i1 points outward toward the lower port, not inward.
  • 端口电流参考方向是向外，不能改成向内后仍保留原答案。The port-current reference is outward; reversing it reverses the answer.

核验依据Verification

独立原图MNA用3组源参数及3个有限负载，得到i=−i1和i=i1−i2，全部原电源、负载功率总和为0。与附录第333页、PDF342页两问一致。Independent original-topology MNA with three parameter sets and three finite loads reproduces i=−i1 and i=i1−i2, with all original source and load powers balancing. Both parts match printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342.

1-43全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第37页／PDF第46页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 37 · PDF p. 46. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

理想源网络最简化：保留端口约束Simplify ideal-source networks by preserving the port law

题目原文Transcribed question

将题图1-41所示各电路化为最简形式。Reduce each circuit in Fig. 1-41 to its simplest form.

(a)u1上正下负直接跨端口，另一支路u2串联向右i1。(b)u1并联向上i2，底部向右i1源串接负端口。(c)i1向上与i2向下并联，负端口串接u1左负右正。(d)u1上正下负，顶u2左正右负，端口另并联向下i1。(a)u1 directly spans the port; another branch has u2 and rightward i1. (b)u1 is parallel with upward i2, and rightward i1 is series with the lower port. (c) Upward i1 and downward i2 are parallel, with bottom-positive-port series u1. (d) Series u1 top-positive and u2 left-positive set the port, with downward i1 parallel.

本题图在书第37页／PDF第46页。The source figure is on printed p. 37 · PDF p. 46.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想电压源固定端电压；理想电流源固定端电流；源串并联端口等效；参考方向。Ideal voltage and current constraints, source equivalence and port references.
判断端口最后受固定电压还是固定电流约束，保留该约束即可。内部源的电流或电压不必保持，但端口u、i关系必须对任何允许负载相同。Identify whether the port is fixed by a voltage or current law and retain that law. Internal quantities can change, but the port u–i relation must hold for any admissible load.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a) 并联理想电压源(a): a directly parallel voltage source

u1直接跨端口，故最简为上正下负电压源u1。u1 directly spans the port, so the equivalent is a top-positive ideal voltage source u1.

u(a)=u1

(b) 串联电流源决定端口流量(b): a series current source fixes terminal flow

底部i1向右流出网络，上端流出i=−i1。可画向下i1的电流源；等价于向上参考值−i1。Bottom i1 leaves rightward, so upper outward current is −i1. Draw a downward i1 source, equivalently an upward-reference −i1 source.

i(b)=−i1

(c) 并联电流源代数合成(c): combine parallel current sources

上节点净注入i1−i2，底部串联电压源不改变端口电流。最简为从下端向上端的电流源i1−i2。Net upper injection is i1−i2; the series lower voltage source does not alter port current. The equivalent current source is i1−i2 upward.

i(c)=i1−i2

(d) 串联电压源相减(d): subtract opposed series voltages

端口上节点电位为u1−u2，向下并联电流源只改变内部源电流。最简为上正下负电压源u1−u2。The upper-port potential is u1−u2. The parallel current source changes only internal source currents, so use a top-positive voltage source u1−u2.

u(d)=u1−u2

四图最简等效：(a)u1电压源上正下负；(b)i1电流源向下，端口外流为−i1；(c)i1−i2电流源向上；(d)u1−u2电压源上正下负。Four equivalents: (a) top-positive voltage u1; (b) current i1 downward, outward port current −i1; (c) current i1−i2 upward; (d) top-positive voltage u1−u2.

(a) 电压源u1；(b) 向下电流源i1（或向上−i1）；(c) 向上电流源i1−i2；(d) 上正下负电压源u1−u2。图示保留原端口方向。(a) Voltage source u1; (b) downward current source i1, or upward −i1; (c) upward current source i1−i2; (d) top-positive voltage source u1−u2. See equivalent diagrams with original port references.

易错点Common errors

  • 最简等效保证端口关系，不保证每个内部源功率相同。A simplest equivalent preserves port behavior, not every original source’s power.
  • (b)若画向上的源，应标−i1；若画向下，应标i1。In (b), label an upward source −i1 or a downward source i1.

核验依据Verification

独立对四个原拓扑各取3组参数、3个负载，36个原电路MNA均符合相应最简端口律，全部原源与负载功率和为0。四结果与附录第333页、PDF342页一致；另绘原生SVG最简电路，标出极性与源箭头。Independent original-topology MNA checks four circuits with three parameter sets and three loads each. All 36 match the simplest port laws and have zero full power residuals. All four agree with printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342. Native SVG equivalents show polarities and current arrows.

1-44全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第37页／PDF第46页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 37 · PDF p. 46. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

画最简戴维南电路：开路电压与去源电阻Draw the simplest Thevenin forms: open voltage and resistance

题目原文Transcribed question

画出题图1-42所示各电路的最简形式。Draw the simplest forms of the circuits in Fig. 1-42.

(a)a经5V左正右负源到C，C经2Ω到b且有2A由b向上注入C。(b)a经1Ω到10V源上负下正的上端C，1A从b向上注入a。(c)8V上正下负源经4Ω到C，C经4Ω到b、经3Ω到a，a经5Ω到b。(a)a connects through left-positive 5V to C, with 2ΩC−to−b and 2A upward b−to−C. (b)a connects through 1Ω to C at the negative top of a10V source; 1A enters a from b. (c)A top-positive 8V source feeds 4Ω to C; C has 4Ω to b and 3Ω to a; a has internal 5Ω to b.

本题图在书第37页／PDF第46页。The source figure is on printed p. 37 · PDF p. 46.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

戴维南等效；开路电压；独立电压源短路、电流源开路求电阻；端口外流电流。Thevenin equivalence, open-circuit voltage, source deactivation and outward port current.
分别求a对b的开路电压Vth与去源后的Rth，再画理想电压源串联电阻。(c)的5Ω属于网络内部，开路外端口时不能删掉。Find Vth from a to b and Rth after deactivation, then draw a series voltage source and resistor. In (c), the 5Ω is internal and remains when the external port is open.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a) Norton部分先变成电压源(a): transform the Norton part

2A并联2Ω给C对b开路4V，再加a对C的5V，Vth=9V。去源后5V短路、2A开路，只剩2Ω。The 2A2Ω Norton part gives C−to−b open voltage 4V. Adding 5V from C to a gives Vth=9V. Deactivation leaves 2Ω.

Vth,a=9V,Rth,a=2Ω

(b) 注意10V源反极性(b): retain the reversed 10V polarity

C对b为−10V。开路时1A经1Ω从a流向C，a比C高1V，所以Vth=−9V，去源后Rth=1Ω。图中用9V源下正上负表示。C is −10V relative to b. With the port open, 1A runs from a through 1Ω to C, so a is 1V higher: Vth=−9V and Rth=1Ω. The diagram uses a9V source positive at the bottom.

Vth,b=−9V,Rth,b=1Ω

(c) 先简化左半，再保留内部5Ω(c): reduce the left part and retain internal 5Ω

左8V与两个4Ω对C−b等效为4V串联2Ω，再串3Ω得到4V串5Ω。它与内部5Ω连接，开路a−b电压分为2V；去源后两条5Ω并联，Rth=2.5Ω。The left 8 V and two−4Ω part is 4V in series with 2Ω at C−b. Adding 3Ω gives 4V with series 5Ω. Internal 5Ω halves the open output to 2V; after deactivation two 5Ω paths are parallel, giving 2.5Ω.

Vth,c=455+5=2V,Rth,c=5∥5=52Ω

写端口律并画电路Write the port laws and draw

定义iout从a向负载流出，三图依次满足u=9−2iout、u=−9−iout、u=2−2.5iout。最简图中源极性与这些符号保持一致。With iout leaving a, the three laws are u=9−2iout, u=−9−iout and u=2−2.5iout. Source polarities in the simplest diagrams preserve these signs.

三个最简戴维南电路：(a)9V源上正下负串2Ω；(b)9V源上负下正串1Ω；(c)2V源上正下负串2.5Ω。端口a在上、b在下。Three simplest Thevenin circuits: (a) top-positive 9V with 2Ω; (b) bottom-positive 9V with 1Ω; (c) top-positive 2V with 2.5Ω. Port a is upper, b lower.

(a)9V上正下负源串2Ω；(b)9V下正上负源串1Ω；(c)2V上正下负源串2.5Ω。(a) Top-positive 9V in series with 2Ω; (b) bottom-positive 9V in series with 1Ω; (c) top-positive 2V in series with 2.5Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 端口外部开路不等于删除网络内部5Ω。Opening the external port does not remove internal 5Ω.
  • (b)开路电压是−9V，不能只因源标10V就写正值。The open voltage in (b) is −9V; preserve source polarity.

核验依据Verification

独立保留每图所有原元件，分别检查开路及2、5、10Ω负载，12个MNA结果严格满足对应戴维南端口律。再独立去源加1V测试，得到2、1、52Ω；所有原电路功率和为0。附录第333页未列1-44，原图与两种独立端口检查构成依据。Independent MNA retains every original element under open circuit and 2, 5 and 10Ω loads. All 12 satisfy the Thevenin laws exactly. Separate deactivated-source 1V tests give 2, 1 and 52Ω, and all original powers balance. The appendix omits 1-44; the original figures and both independent port checks support these results.

1-45指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第37页／PDF第46页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 37 · PDF p. 46. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：1-45Assigned requirement: 1-45

电源等效变换：先合并为诺顿源Source transformation: combine Norton sources first

题目原文Transcribed question

利用电源等效变换求题图1-43所示电路中的电流i。Use source equivalence transformations to find the current i in Fig. 1-43.

三个支路并联于上、下公共节点。左支路为1Ω电阻串联9V电压源（上正下负）；中支路为2Ω串联4V电压源（上负下正）；右支路7Ω，i向下。Three branches share upper and lower nodes. The left has 1Ω in series with a9V source positive at the top. The middle has 2Ω in series with a4V source positive at the bottom. The right has 7Ω with i downward.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

电压源与串联电阻的诺顿等效；电流源并联；分流公式。Norton transformation of a voltage source and series resistor; parallel sources; current division.
两电压源的正端相反，变换后电流源方向也相反。先作带符号的电流源合并，再对7Ω负载分流。The sources have opposite polarities, so their transformed current sources oppose. Combine their signed currents before finding the 7Ω branch current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

变换左支路Transform the left branch

9V串联1Ω等效为9A向上电流源并联1Ω，使上节点开路电位为正。The 9V source with 1Ω becomes a9A upward current source in parallel with 1Ω, preserving a positive open-circuit upper potential.

IN1=91=9A(up)

变换中支路并合并Transform and combine the middle branch

4V源正端在底部，等效电流源为2A向下。两源净电流为7A向上，内阻为1Ω与2Ω并联。The 4V source is positive at the bottom, so its Norton current is 2A downward. The net current is 7A upward, with 1Ω and 2Ω in parallel.

IN=9−42=7A,RN=1∥2=23Ω

计算负载分流Find load current by division

7A在内阻23Ω和负载7Ω之间分流。i沿7Ω向下，为正。The 7A divides between 23Ω and the 7Ω load. Current i is positive downward through the load.

i=INRNRN+7=72323+7=1423A≈0.608696A

i=1423A≈0.609A，向下。i=1423A≈0.609A, downward.

易错点Common errors

  • 中支路4V源的正端在下方，不能把两个诺顿电流源都取向上。The 4V source is positive at the lower terminal; its Norton source must oppose the 9A source.
  • 源等效保持端口特性，不保证变换前后内部元件的功率逐项相同。Source equivalence preserves port behavior, not every internal element power.

核验依据Verification

直接对原电路独立列KCL：(V−9)1+(V+4)2+V7=0，得V=9823V，i=V7=1423A。书第333页、PDF342页1-45列0.61A，与精确值四舍五入一致。Independent original-circuit KCL gives (V−9)1+(V+4)2+V7=0, so V=9823V and i=V7=1423A. Answer 1-45 on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 gives 0.61A, matching the rounded exact value.

1-46全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第37页／PDF第46页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 37 · PDF p. 46. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

电源等效变换求电流：两边化成戴维南支路Source transformations: reduce both sides to Thevenin branches

题目原文Transcribed question

利用电源等效变换求题图1-44所示电路中的电流i。Use source transformations to find current i in Fig. 1-44.

左3A源向上，经顶2Ω接15V源正端A，源负端B经底2Ω到公共底节点0；A经3Ω到M，M经6Ω到底且i向下。M经10Ω到C；C有5A向下源，并有4Ω、4V上负下正源、4Ω串联回到底。Upward 3A feeds top 2Ω into A at the positive terminal of 15V; its negative B connects through bottom 2Ω to ground. A connects through 3Ω to M, with 6Ω to ground carrying downward i. M connects through 10Ω to C, which has downward 5A and a series path of 4Ω, bottom-positive 4V, and 4Ω to ground.

本题图在书第37页／PDF第46页。The source figure is on printed p. 37 · PDF p. 46.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

理想源支路端口等效；Norton、戴维南变换；串联电阻；节点法核验。Ideal-source port equivalence, Norton and Thevenin transformations, series resistors and nodal verification.
以6Ω两端为观察端口。左15V理想源固定自身电压，旁边3A串2Ω只影响内部电流；左侧对端口可化15V串5Ω。右侧先把两4Ω及反向4V源化简，再与5A源合并。View the network from the 6Ω terminals. The left 15V source fixes its voltage, making the side 3A2Ω branch irrelevant to that port law; the left branch is 15V in series with 5Ω. On the right, reduce the two 4Ω and reversed 4V source, then combine with 5A.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

左侧化成15V串5ΩReduce the left side to 15V and 5Ω

左支路3Ω、15V源和底2Ω串联，对M到底的关系为IL=(VM−15)5。左端3A支路并在理想15V源旁，只改变该电压源电流。The left path contains 3Ω, the 15V source and bottom 2Ω, giving IL=(VM−15)5. The adjacent 3A branch changes the ideal voltage-source current but not this port relation.

IL=VM−155

右侧化成−44V串18ΩReduce the right side to −44V and 18Ω

C到底的串联支路总电阻8Ω，电压源沿向下为−4V，故电流(VC+4)8。再加向下5A，总电流=VC8+112，对应戴维南开路−44V、内阻8Ω。再串顶10Ω，得到−44V串18Ω。The C−to-ground series path has 8Ω and a−4V downward source drop, so its current is (VC+4)8. Adding downward 5A gives VC8+112, equivalent to open voltage −44V and 8Ω. Adding top 10Ω yields −44V in series with 18Ω.

IR=VM+4418

并联三支路求负载电流Solve the three parallel branches

M点列KCL：(VM−15)5+(VM+44)18+VM6=0，解得VM=2519V，i=VM6=25114A。KCL at M gives (VM−15)5+(VM+44)18+VM6=0, hence VM=2519V and i=25114A.

VM−155+VM+4418+VM6=0⇒i=25114A≈0.219298A

i=25114A≈0.2193A，按原图向下；按两位小数约0.22A。i=25114A≈0.2193A downward, or 0.22A to two decimals.

易错点Common errors

  • 右4V源上负下正，等效开路电压为−44V，不能取+44V。The right 4V source is bottom-positive, making the reduced open voltage −44V.
  • 左底2Ω不与顶2Ω同属一个无分支串联路径，应从端口保留正确3+2Ω。Do not combine the two left 2Ω blindly; the relevant port series path is 3+2Ω.

核验依据Verification

独立完整七节点MNA保留3A、15V、5A、反向4V及全部七电阻，得到M=2519V、i=25114A；与等效三支路KCL完全一致，所有原元件吸收功率总和精确为0。附录第333页、PDF342页0.22A是两位小数舍入。Independent full seven-node MNA retains all sources and seven resistors, giving M=2519V and i=25114A. It exactly matches reduced-branch KCL, with zero sum of all original absorbed powers. The appendix’s0.22A on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 is rounded to two decimals.

1-47全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第37页／PDF第46页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 37 · PDF p. 46. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

指定电压源零电流：先把其支路电阻压降置零Zero source current: set its series resistor drop to zero

题目原文Transcribed question

如题图1-45所示电路，欲使电压源us中的电流为零，试确定电阻Rx的值。For Fig. 1-45, determine Rx such that current through voltage source us is zero.

底部公共。右5V源us上正下负，经5Ω接节点A，A经Rx到底、经顶2Ω到T。T经4Ω到N；N经2Ω到底，控制u上正下负，并由0.5A源向上注入。左受控电压源3.5u上正下负，经1Ω接T。Bottom is common. A top-positive 5V source us connects through 5Ω to A; A has Rx to ground and top 2Ω to T. T connects through 4Ω to N; N has 2Ω to ground with top-positive control u and receives upward 0.5A. A top-positive dependent source 3.5u connects through 1Ω to T.

本题图在书第37页／PDF第46页。The source figure is on printed p. 37 · PDF p. 46.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

零电流串联支路压降为0；VCVS控制；节点KCL；反求电阻。Zero current implies zero series-resistor drop, VCVS control, nodal KCL and resistance recovery.
us电流为0也使右5Ω电流为0，故A直接等于5V。先在这个目标条件下解T、N，再由A的KCL求Rx，最后接回原图验证。Zero us current also makes the right 5Ω current zero, fixing A=5V. Solve T and N under this target, use A−node KCL for Rx, then restore the full circuit to verify.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

把零电流目标化为A电位Convert the target into A potential

右5Ω无压降，因此VA=5V。令N电位u，左受控源上端K=3.5u。The right 5Ω has no drop, so VA=5V. Let N be u; the controlled source’s upper terminal K is 3.5u.

VA=5,VN=u,VK=72u

对N和T列KCLApply KCL at N and T

N点：(u−VT)4+u2=0.5，得VT=3u−2。T点：(VT−3.5u)+(VT−u)4+(VT−5)2=0。联立得u=4、VT=10V。At N, (u−VT)4+u2=0.5, giving VT=3u−2. Combining with T−node KCL gives u=4V and VT=10V.

VT=3u−2,7VT−15u=10⇒u=4, VT=10(V)

求Rx并回代目标Find Rx and restore the target

T经2Ω向A流(10−5)2=2.5A，右5Ω不取电流，所以Rx承担全部2.5A。Rx=52.5=2Ω。The top 2Ω sends (10−5)2=2.5A into A. With zero current in the right 5Ω, all 2.5A flows through Rx, giving 2Ω.

Rx=5(10−5)2=2Ω

Rx=2Ω。Rx=2Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 零的是5V源支路电流，不是Rx或整个网络电流。Only the 5V source-branch current is zero, not Rx current or all network current.
  • 受控源3.5u必须保留，不能在求Rx时去掉。Keep the dependent source 3.5u active.

核验依据Verification

独立原VCVS拓扑MNA恢复Rx=2Ω，得N=4、T=10、K=14、A=5V，5V源电流精确为0。六电阻总耗散58W；0.5A源提供2W，受控源提供56W，5V源功率0，完全平衡。与附录第333页、PDF342页2Ω一致。Independent original−VCVSMNA with Rx=2Ω gives N=4, T=10, K=14 and A=5V, with exactly zero current through the 5V source. Six resistors dissipate 58W; the current source supplies 2W and dependent source 56W, while the 5V source exchanges zero power. This matches 2Ω in the appendix.

1-48全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第37页／PDF第46页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 37 · PDF p. 46. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

四端网络吸收功率：先补第4端电流再选参考Four-terminal absorbed power: recover the fourth current

题目原文Transcribed question

已知题图1-46所示四端网络的外部电压分别为U12=5V，U32=10V，U41=−15V，1、2、3端的电流分别如图中所示，试求此四端网络吸收的功率。For the four-terminal network in Fig. 1-46, U12=5V, U32=10V and U41=−15V. Currents at terminals 1, 2 and 3 are shown. Find the power absorbed by the network.

菱形四端网络：1在左，5A向右流入；2在上，1A向上流出；3在右，2A向右流出；4在下，电流未知。A diamond four-terminal network: terminal 1 left has 5A entering rightward; 2 top has 1A leaving upward; 3 right has 2A leaving rightward; terminal 4 bottom has unknown current.

本题图在书第37页／PDF第46页。The source figure is on printed p. 37 · PDF p. 46.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

多端网络KCL；电位差Uxy=Vx−Vy；向内电流功率求和；参考电位不变性。Multi-terminal KCL, Uxy=Vx−Vy, inward-current power sums and reference invariance.
把所有端电流统一定义为流入网络，再补第4端。任选一端作0V，用已给电压恢复其他端电位，求∑Vkik。Define every terminal current inward, find the fourth by KCL, choose a voltage reference and evaluate ∑Vkik.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

补第4端电流Recover terminal-4 current

向内为正时i1=5、i2=−1、i3=−2A，总和0给i4=−2A，即第4端实际流出2A。With inward positive, i1=5, i2=−1 and i3=−2A. Their total with i4 is zero, so i4=−2A, actually 2A outward.

i4=−(5−1−2)=−2A

恢复各端电位Recover terminal potentials

取V2=0，则V1=5、V3=10V。U41=V4−V1=−15V，所以V4=−10V。Choose V2=0. Then V1=5 and V3=10V. Since U41=V4−V1=−15V, V4=−10V.

(V1,V2,V3,V4)=(5,0,10,−10)V

求总吸收功率Sum absorbed terminal powers

P=5×5+0×(−1)+10×(−2)+(−10)×(−2)=25W，正值表示网络净吸收。P=5×5+0×(−1)+10×(−2)+(−10)×(−2)=25W. Positive means net absorption.

Pabs=∑k=14Vkik=25W

四端网络吸收25W；第4端电流为流出2A。The network absorbs 25W; terminal 4 carries 2A outward.

易错点Common errors

  • U41是−15V，且下标顺序表示V4−V1。U41 is −15V and means V4−V1.
  • 不能只算已给的三个端子，第四端也输送功率。Include the fourth terminal’s power even though its current was not initially given.

核验依据Verification

独立KCL与参考平移核验：四个向内电流之和0；把所有电位共同平移0、7、−10、1.5V后，全部给定电压差不变，∑Vkik始终精确25W。与附录第333页、PDF342页25W一致。Independent KCL and reference-shift checks: inward currents sum to zero. Shifting all potentials by 0, 7, −10 or 1.5V preserves all given differences and leaves ∑Vkik exactly 25W. This matches 25W in the appendix.

1-49全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第37页／PDF第46页。范围状态：讲授范围内。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 37 · PDF p. 46. Coverage: within the taught chapter.

风扇四档设计：给定比值只能确定一个电阻解族Four-speed fan: ratios determine a family of resistor designs

题目原文Transcribed question

题图1-47所示为散热风扇的转速控制电路原理图。假设开关置于1时的风扇转速为v1，现要求开关置于2、3、4时风扇的转速分别为3v1、4v1和5v1，且假设风扇转速与通过电动机的电流成比例，电动机看作电阻元件，电阻为RL=100Ω。试确定电阻R1、R2、R3和R4的标称电阻值。Fig. 1-47 shows a cooling-fan speed controller. Speed at switch position 1 is v1; positions 2, 3 and 4 must give 3v1, 4v1 and 5v1. Assume speed is proportional to motor current and model the motor as RL=100Ω. Determine nominal R1, R2, R3 and R4.

12V电池经点火开关、30A熔断器及四档转换开关供电。位置1接R1上端，位置2接R1R2间，位置3接R2R3间，位置4接R3R4间。下方R4接100Ω电动机回电池负端。A12V battery feeds an ignition switch, 30A fuse and four-position selector. Positions 1–4 connect respectively above R1 and at the R1 and R2, R2 and R3 and R3 and R4 taps. R4 connects through the 100Ω motor back to battery negative.

本题图在书第37页／PDF第46页。The source figure is on printed p. 37 · PDF p. 46.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

速度比等于电流比；串联总电阻与电流反比；欠定设计与自由参数；区分熔断器额定值和工作电流。Speed ratios equal current ratios, series resistance is inverse to current, underdetermined design parameters and fuse rating versus operating current.
只给四档相对速度，没有给基准绝对电流或最高档绝对速度。三条独立比值约束不足以唯一确定四个电阻；应给完整解族，再明确选一个自由参数提供可行设计。Only relative speeds are given, with no absolute base current or highest speed. Three independent ratios cannot uniquely determine four resistors. Give the full family, then state a free-parameter choice for a valid design.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

把速度比变成总电阻比Convert speed ratios to total resistances

设一档电流I1，四档电流为I1、3I1、4I1、5I1。各档串联总电阻依次为12I1、12(3I1)、12(4I1)、12(5I1)。The four currents are I1, 3I1, 4I1 and 5I1, so their series totals are 12I1, 12(3I1), 12(4I1) and 12(5I1).

I1:I2:I3:I4=1:3:4:5

保留R4为自由设计量Retain R4 as a free design variable

令R4=r≥0Ω，最高档总电阻T4=100+r。由电流比，T1=5(100+r)、T2=5(100+r)3、T3=5(100+r)4。相邻档总电阻之差给各电阻。Let R4=r≥0Ω. Highest-position total T4=100+r. The ratios imply T1=5(100+r), T2=5(100+r)3 and T3=5(100+r)4. Differences of adjacent totals give the resistors.

R1=103(100+r),R2=512(100+r),R3=14(100+r),R4=r(Ω)

给一组明确条件下的可行值Give a design under an explicit choice

例如选择r=20Ω，则R1=400、R2=50、R3=30、R4=20Ω。四档总电阻为600、200、150、120Ω，电流为20、60、80、100mA，速度比严格1:3:4:5。For example choose r=20Ω. Then R1=400, R2=50, R3=30 and R4=20Ω. Totals are 600, 200, 150 and 120Ω; currents are 20, 60, 80 and 100mA, giving exactly 1:3:4:5.

r=20Ω⇒(R1,R2,R3,R4)=(400,50,30,20)Ω

说明欠定与标称值含义State the remaining design freedom

上例是可行选择而非原题唯一答案。若要求唯一值，还须指定一档电流、某档绝对速度及电机比例常数，或指定一个电阻。30A是熔断器标注，不是已知风扇工作电流，不能拿来补方程。若要求四电阻严格为正，取r>0。The example is a valid choice, not a uniquely implied answer. A unique design needs an absolute current, an absolute speed with motor proportionality constant, or one resistor value. The 30A fuse rating is not operating current and supplies no missing equation. Choose r>0 if all four resistors must be strictly positive.

原题欠定。完整非负电阻解族：R4=r≥0，R1=(103)(100+r)，R2=(512)(100+r)，R3=(14)(100+r)，单位Ω。选R4=20Ω可取(400,50,30,20) Ω，严格满足四档比值。The problem is underdetermined. For any r≥0Ω: R4=r, R1=(103)(100+r), R2=(512)(100+r), R3=(14)(100+r), in Ω. Choosing R4=20Ω gives (400,50,30,20) Ω and exactly meets all speed ratios.

易错点Common errors

  • 四个电阻不能由三条独立速度比条件唯一解出。Three independent speed ratios do not uniquely determine four resistors.
  • 开关越往下接入，旁路的上方电阻越多，不是给电动机并联额外电阻。Lower switch taps bypass more upper series resistors; they do not place extra resistors parallel with the motor.
  • 不要把30A熔断器额定电流当成风扇的实际电流。Do not use the 30A fuse rating as the actual fan current.

核验依据Verification

独立按原抽头链路构建全部四电阻和100Ω电机的MNA，分别选择r=20、60Ω，再逐档接12V，共8个原电路验证；每组电流比精确1:3:4:5，未接入的上段电阻电流为0，每档电源与各电阻功率总和平衡。两组不同的正电阻解直接证明非唯一。附录未列1-49，不补造唯一答案。Independent MNA retains the original tapped chain, all four resistors and the 100Ω motor. Two choices r=20 and 60Ω are tested at all four 12V switch connections: all eight circuits give exact ratios 1:3:4:5, zero current in inactive upper sections and full power balance. Two distinct positive designs directly demonstrate nonuniqueness. The appendix omits 1-49; no unique answer is invented.

2-1全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第61页／PDF第70页。范围状态：考试范围（图论与基本分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70. Coverage: required: graph theory and basic analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

每图找5棵树：只保留连接全部节点的无环支路Five trees per graph: connected, spanning and acyclic

题目原文Transcribed question

试找出题图2-1所示各连通图G的5个可能的树。Find five possible spanning trees for each connected graph G in Fig. 2-1.

(a)顶端从左到右四节点A、B、C、D，底节点E。支路1=A−E、2=A−B、3=B−E、4=B−C、5=C−E、6=C−D、7=D−E。(b)A左上、B中上、C右上、D左下、E右下；1=A−D、2=A−B、3=C−A弧线、4=D−B、5=B−C、6=B−E、7=E−C、8=E−D。(a) Four upper nodes A–D and lower E: edges 1=A−E, 2=A−B, 3=B−E, 4=B−C, 5=C−E, 6=C−D, 7=D−E. (b)A upper-left, B upper-middle, C upper-right, D lower-left, E lower-right: 1=A−D, 2=A−B, 3=C−A arc, 4=D−B, 5=B−C, 6=B−E, 7=E−C, 8=E−D.

本题图在书第61页／PDF第70页。The source figure is on printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

树包含全部节点且连通、无回路；n节点树恰有n−1条树支；判断树时不考虑支路参考箭头。A spanning tree contains every vertex, is connected and acyclic, and has n−1 edges; edge-reference arrows do not affect tree membership.
两图都是5个节点，因此每棵树选4条边。先找一棵易识别的连通树，再交换一条边，确认既没有断开也没有闭环；每幅图需给5棵，共10棵。Both graphs have five vertices, so select four edges per tree. Start from an obvious tree, exchange edges while retaining connectivity and avoiding cycles, and provide five trees for each graph.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

固定判据Fix the criterion

5个节点的连通子图若恰含4条边，自动无环，故只需逐组确认全部节点连通；不能漏掉孤立节点。A connected five-vertex subgraph with exactly four edges is acyclic. Check that every original vertex is connected, including any vertex that might otherwise become isolated.

|T|=n−1=4,T connected

(a) 五棵可行树(a): five valid trees

可选T1={1,3,5,7}；T2={2,3,5,7}；T3={1,3,4,7}；T4={1,3,5,6}；T5={2,4,6,7}。T1是以E为中心的星形树；T5是沿A−B−C−D−E的路径树。Choose T1={1,3,5,7}, T2={2,3,5,7}, T3={1,3,4,7}, T4={1,3,5,6}, T5={2,4,6,7}. T1 is a star centered at E and T5 the path A−B−C−D−E.

(b) 五棵可行树(b): five valid trees

可选T1={1,2,5,7}；T2={2,4,5,6}；T3={1,3,5,8}；T4={2,4,6,7}；T5={3,4,5,6}。例如T2以B为中心连接A、C、D、E，明显无环。Choose T1={1,2,5,7}, T2={2,4,5,6}, T3={1,3,5,8}, T4={2,4,6,7}, T5={3,4,5,6}. For example, T2 is the star at B connecting A, C, D and E.

(a) {1,3,5,7}、{2,3,5,7}、{1,3,4,7}、{1,3,5,6}、{2,4,6,7}；(b) {1,2,5,7}、{2,4,5,6}、{1,3,5,8}、{2,4,6,7}、{3,4,5,6}。答案不唯一，以上每组均为树。(a) {1,3,5,7}, {2,3,5,7}, {1,3,4,7}, {1,3,5,6}, {2,4,6,7}. (b) {1,2,5,7}, {2,4,5,6}, {1,3,5,8}, {2,4,6,7}, {3,4,5,6}. Many answers are possible; all ten listed sets are valid trees.

易错点Common errors

  • 只数到4条边还不够，必须连接原图全部5个节点。Four edges alone are insufficient; all five original vertices must be connected.
  • 有向图的树采用底层无向连通性，不要求沿参考箭头可达。Tree membership uses underlying undirected connectivity, not reachability along reference arrows.

核验依据Verification

独立枚举每图全部4边子集并做连通、无环检查，所列10组全部通过且每图5组互不重复。再用拉普拉斯矩阵余子式的矩阵树定理独立核对，全部树数为(a)21棵、(b)45棵，与穷举完全一致。附录第333页未列2-1，所列是经验证的可行答案而非声称唯一。Independent enumeration checks every four-edge subset and verifies all ten selected sets, with five distinct trees per graph. A separate Laplacian-minor matrix-tree calculation gives 21 and 45 total trees, exactly matching enumeration. The appendix omits 2-1; the listed answers are verified examples, not unique choices.

2-2全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第61页／PDF第70页。范围状态：考试范围（图论与基本分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70. Coverage: required: graph theory and basic analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

树与割集分别判断：能断开还要没有冗余支路Classify trees and cutsets separately: disconnection must be minimal

题目原文Transcribed question

在题图2-2所示连通图G中，说明支路集合(4,5,8,9)、(1,4,6,7)、(1,4,6,7,8)、(3,4,9)、(2,5,6,8,9)、(2,6,7)哪些可以构成树，哪些可以构成割集。For connected graph G in Fig. 2-2, determine which branch sets (4,5,8,9), (1,4,6,7), (1,4,6,7,8), (3,4,9), (2,5,6,8,9) and (2,6,7) are spanning trees and which are cutsets.

外三角顶T、左下L、右下R，内三角顶U、左V、右W。支路1=T−R、2=U−W、3=L−V、4=T−L、5=T−U、6=U−V、7=V−W、8=W−R、9=L−R。Outer triangle vertices T top, L lower-left, R lower-right; inner U top, V left, W right. Edges: 1=T−R, 2=U−W, 3=L−V, 4=T−L, 5=T−U, 6=U−V, 7=V−W, 8=W−R, 9=L−R.

本题图在书第61页／PDF第70页。The source figure is on printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

6节点树须5条边且连通无环；本题割集采用包含意义下极小断开集；树与割集两种性质可同时成立。A six-vertex tree has five edges and is connected and acyclic. Here a cutset is an inclusion-minimal disconnecting set. Tree and cutset properties can overlap.
对每个集合做两个独立测试：保留这些边能否成为生成树；删除这些边能否断图，且少删其中任一条就不再断开。割集的“极小”不是说边数必须全图最少。Apply two independent tests: does keeping the set form a spanning tree, and does deleting it disconnect the graph minimally? Minimal means no selected edge is redundant, not globally fewest edges.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

逐项检查前两组Check the first two sets

{4,5,8,9}只有4条边，不是6节点树；删去后形成{T,R}与{L,U,V,W}两块，四条都是跨块边，构成割集。{1,4,6,7}也只有4条边，且删去后原图仍连通，两者都不是。{4,5,8,9} has only four edges, so is not a tree. Deletion separates {T,R} and {L,U,V,W}, with all four removed edges crossing the partition: it is a cutset. {1,4,6,7} has only four edges and its deletion leaves the graph connected, so is neither.

第三组既是树又是割集The third set is both

{1,4,6,7,8}连通全部6节点、共5条边，是树。删去后分成{T,U,W}和{L,V,R}，五条均为跨块边且无冗余，也是割集。{1,4,6,7,8} spans all six vertices with five edges, so is a tree. Its deletion separates {T,U,W} and {L,V,R}; every removed edge crosses the partition, so it is also a cutset.

第四组隔离左下节点The fourth set isolates the lower-left node

{3,4,9}恰是外左节点L的三条关联边，删去后L孤立；少删任何一条L就仍接回其余图，故是割集。它不包含全部节点的生成树。{3,4,9} consists of the three edges incident to L. Removing all isolates L, while retaining any one reconnects it, so it is a cutset but not a spanning tree.

第五组有树性质，但断开集有冗余The fifth is a tree but its disconnection set is redundant

{2,5,6,8,9}是5边连通生成树。删去它会断图，但只删{2,5,6}已能隔离内顶U，8、9是冗余边；按本题极小割集定义，它不是割集。{2,5,6,8,9} is a connected five-edge spanning tree. Deleting it disconnects the graph, but {2,5,6} alone already isolates U; edges 8 and 9 are redundant. Thus it is not a minimal cutset.

第六组两者都不是The sixth is neither

{2,6,7}只是内三角形，既有回路又未连接外节点，不是树；删去后外三角和三根连接边仍连接所有节点，不是割集。{2,6,7} is only the inner triangle, cyclic and nonspanning, so not a tree. Deletion leaves the outer triangle and three links connecting every vertex, so it is not a cutset.

树：{1,4,6,7,8}、{2,5,6,8,9}。割集：{4,5,8,9}、{1,4,6,7,8}、{3,4,9}。其余集合不属于相应类别；第三组同时属于两类。Trees: {1,4,6,7,8} and {2,5,6,8,9}. Cutsets: {4,5,8,9}, {1,4,6,7,8} and {3,4,9}. The third set belongs to both categories.

易错点Common errors

  • 删除后断开只是必要条件，还须检验割集中每条边是否不可少。Disconnection alone is insufficient; every edge of the cutset must be necessary.
  • 同一边集合可以既是生成树又是割集，不能二选一。An edge set can be both a spanning tree and a cutset; the labels are not exclusive.

核验依据Verification

独立图算法对6个集合分别做生成树连通性、删除后的连通分量、逐条恢复边的极小性检查。树判定依次为否、否、是、否、是、否；割集为是、否、是、是、否、否。对第五组另用真子集{2,5,6}反证极小性。与附录第333页、PDF342页完全一致。Independent graph tests check spanning connectivity, deletion components and minimality by restoring each removed edge. Tree results are F,F,T,F,T,F; cutsets T,F,T,T,F,F. The proper subset {2,5,6} independently disproves minimality of the fifth set. Results exactly match printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342.

2-3指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第61页／PDF第70页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2-3Assigned requirement: 2-3

一棵树确定全部基本割集与基本回路One spanning tree determines all fundamental cutsets and loops

题目原文Transcribed question

在题图2−1(b)中选树T(3,4,5,6)，分别找出对应的基本割集和基本回路。In Fig. 2-1(b), choose the spanning tree T= (3, 4, 5, 6). Find the corresponding fundamental cutsets and fundamental loops.

为说明拓扑，临时将左、中、右上、左下、右下节点依次命名A、B、C、D、E。有向支路为1:A→D，2:A→B，3:C→A，4:D→B，5:B→C，6:B→E，7:E→C，8:E→D。图中的G为图名。For description, label the left, center, upper-right, lower-left and lower-right nodes A, B, C, D and E. Directed edges are 1: A→D, 2: A→B, 3: C→A, 4: D→B, 5: B→C, 6: B→E, 7: E→C and 8: E→D. G in the source figure denotes the graph.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

树、树支、连支、基本割集与基本回路定义。Spanning trees, twigs, links, fundamental cutsets and fundamental loops.
基本割集逐根删除树支求；基本回路逐根加入连支求。每组必须恰含一个对应树支或连支，不能枚举任意割集、任意回路。Find each fundamental cutset by deleting one twig, and each fundamental loop by adding one link. Use the specified tree rather than enumerating arbitrary cuts or loops.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

确定树支和连支数量Identify twigs and links

全图5个节点、8条支路。给定4条树支3、4、5、6连通全图且不成环；剩余连支为1、2、7、8。The graph has 5 nodes and 8 edges. Twigs 3, 4, 5 and 6 connect all nodes without a cycle. Links are 1, 2, 7 and 8.

n=5, b=8,n−1=4,b−n+1=4

删树支找基本割集Delete each twig for its fundamental cutset

删3后A与其余节点分开，跨分区边为1、2、3；删4后D孤立，跨边为1、4、8；删5后{A,C}与{B,D,E}分开，跨边为1、2、5、7；删6后E孤立，跨边为6、7、8。Deleting 3 isolates A, giving edges 1,2,3. Deleting 4 isolates D, giving 1,4,8. Deleting 5 separates {A,C} from {B,D,E}, giving 1,2,5,7. Deleting 6 isolates E, giving 6,7,8.

C3={1,2,3},C4={1,4,8},C5={1,2,5,7},C6={6,7,8}

加连支找基本回路Add each link for its fundamental loop

加入连支1，沿树中D→B→C→A闭合，得到{1,3,4,5}；加入2得到{2,3,5}；加入7得到{5,6,7}；加入8得到{4,6,8}。集合内部顺序不影响答案。Adding link 1 closes through the tree path D→B→C→A, giving {1,3,4,5}. Adding links 2, 7 and 8 gives {2,3,5}, {5,6,7} and {4,6,8}. Set ordering does not matter.

L1={1,3,4,5},L2={2,3,5},L7={5,6,7},L8={4,6,8}

基本割集：{1,2,3}、{1,4,8}、{1,2,5,7}、{6,7,8}；基本回路：{1,3,4,5}、{2,3,5}、{5,6,7}、{4,6,8}。Fundamental cutsets: {1,2,3}, {1,4,8}, {1,2,5,7}, {6,7,8}. Fundamental loops: {1,3,4,5}, {2,3,5}, {5,6,7}, {4,6,8}.

易错点Common errors

  • 基本割集恰含一条树支，其余为连支；基本回路恰含一条连支，其余为树支。A fundamental cutset contains exactly one twig; a fundamental loop contains exactly one link.
  • 题目只问支路集合；若进一步列KCL、KVL，应另按选定割集或回路方向处理正负号。This question asks for edge sets. Signed KCL and KVL equations additionally require cutset or loop orientations.

核验依据Verification

用保存的有向边表独立进行删边连通分量与树路径检查：4个割集均恰含相应一个树支，4个回路均恰含相应一个连支，数量符合n−1=4和b−n+1=4。书第333页、PDF342页2-3的所有集合相同（书中回路元素顺序略有不同）。An independent edge-table check of components after twig deletion and paths in the tree confirms every cutset and loop; each has exactly its one designated twig or link. Counts match n−1=4 and b−n+1=4. All sets match answer 2-3 on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342, regardless of listed element order.

2-4全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第61页／PDF第70页。范围状态：考试范围（图论与基本分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70. Coverage: required: graph theory and basic analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

基本割集与基本回路：逐条树支、逐条连支构造Fundamental cutsets and loops: one twig or chord at a time

题目原文Transcribed question

在题图2-3所示连通图中选树T(1,3,5,6,8)，分别找出对应的基本割集和基本回路。For Fig. 2-3, choose tree T={1,3,5,6,8}. Find the corresponding fundamental cutsets and fundamental loops.

顶T、左中L、右中R、左下P、中下Q、右下S。有向边1=T→L、2=R→T、3=L→R、4=L→Q、5=P→L、6=Q→P、7=Q→R、8=R→S、9=S→Q。Vertices: top T, middle-left L, middle-right R, bottom-left P, bottom-middle Q, bottom-right S. Directed edges 1=T→L, 2=R→T, 3=L→R, 4=L→Q, 5=P→L, 6=Q→P, 7=Q→R, 8=R→S, 9=S→Q.

本题图在书第61页／PDF第70页。The source figure is on printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

树支和连支；删一条树支形成基本割集；加一条连支形成唯一基本回路；集合不指定绕行方向。Twigs and chords, removing a twig for a fundamental cutset, adding a chord for a unique fundamental loop and unordered branch sets.
树有5条支路，故有5个基本割集；余下2、4、7、9为连支，故有4个基本回路。每个基本割集只含一条树支，每个基本回路只含一条连支。The five twigs give five fundamental cutsets. Chords 2,4,7,9 give four fundamental loops. Each cutset contains one twig; each fundamental loop contains one chord.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

先核实树与连支Check the tree and chords

T={1,3,5,6,8}连通6节点且无环，连支集合为{2,4,7,9}。T={1,3,5,6,8} connects all six vertices without a cycle; the chords are {2,4,7,9}.

T={1,3,5,6,8},T―={2,4,7,9}

逐条删树支求基本割集Remove each twig for its cutset

分别删除树中的1、3、5、6、8，再把原图所有跨两块的边收集起来。对应割集为：Q1={1,2}；Q3={2,3,7,9}；Q5={4,5,7,9}；Q6={4,6,7,9}；Q8={8,9}。Remove each twig from the tree and collect every original edge crossing its two components. The sets are Q1={1,2}, Q3={2,3,7,9}, Q5={4,5,7,9}, Q6={4,6,7,9}, Q8={8,9}.

逐条加连支求基本回路Add each chord for its loop

加连支2，配树中1、3，得L2={1,2,3}；加4得L4={4,5,6}；加7得L7={3,5,6,7}；加9得L9={3,5,6,8,9}。Adding chord 2 gives L2={1,2,3}; chord 4 gives L4={4,5,6}; chord 7 gives L7={3,5,6,7}; chord 9 gives L9={3,5,6,8,9}.

最后检查个数与唯一树支、连支Check counts and unique twig and chord

共有5个割集、4个回路。每个Q只含其标号对应的那一条树支；每个L只含其标号对应的那一条连支，避免误把任意回路当基本回路。There are five cutsets and four loops. Each Q contains only its named twig and each L only its named chord, distinguishing fundamental sets from arbitrary ones.

基本割集（按树支1、3、5、6、8）：{1,2}、{2,3,7,9}、{4,5,7,9}、{4,6,7,9}、{8,9}。基本回路（按连支2、4、7、9）：{1,2,3}、{4,5,6}、{3,5,6,7}、{3,5,6,8,9}。Fundamental cutsets for twigs 1,3,5,6,8: {1,2}, {2,3,7,9}, {4,5,7,9}, {4,6,7,9}, {8,9}. Fundamental loops for chords 2,4,7,9: {1,2,3}, {4,5,6}, {3,5,6,7}, {3,5,6,8,9}.

易错点Common errors

  • 割集要收集原图跨分区的所有边，不只看树中剩余的边。Collect all original crossing edges for a cutset, not just tree edges.
  • 这里答案是支路集合，顺序不表示沿回路的走向；写KVL时再指定绕行方向。These are branch sets; their order does not specify traversal. Choose a direction separately when writing KVL.

核验依据Verification

独立由端点图算法逐树支分区、逐连支搜索树上唯一路径得到全部9个集合。再按原箭头构造带符号基本割集矩阵Qf和回路矩阵Bf，精确核验秩分别5、4，QfBfᵀ=0及节点关联矩阵ABfᵀ=0。与附录第333页、PDF342页全部集合一致；附录最后回路的排列顺序不同但集合相同。Independent endpoint algorithms partition the tree per twig and find the unique tree path per chord, reproducing all nine sets. Signed matrices have exact ranks 5 and 4 and satisfy QfBfᵀ=0 and incidence ABfᵀ=0. All sets match the appendix; its last loop is merely listed in a different order.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第61页／PDF第70页。范围状态：考试范围（图论与基本分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70. Coverage: required: graph theory and basic analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

独立KCL、KVL数：先数节点与支路Independent KCL and KVL counts: vertices and branches first

题目原文Transcribed question

对题图2−1(b)连通图所对应的电路，可写出的独立KCL、KVL方程数分别是多少？For the circuit represented by connected graph Fig. 2-1(b), how many independent KCL and KVL equations can be written?

有5个实心节点、8条编号支路，顶弧线3是单独一条支路，中间节点不在该弧线上。There are five filled vertices and eight numbered branches. Upper arc 3 is a separate branch and does not pass through the middle vertex.

本题图在书第61页／PDF第70页。The source figure is on printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

连通图关联矩阵秩n−1；独立回路数b−n+1。Connected incidence rank n−1 and cycle-space dimension b−n+1.
先数图上真正的节点n=5和支路b=8。不要把参考箭头、弧线或分支标号当新节点。Count actual vertices n=5 and edges b=8. Arrows, curves and labels do not create vertices.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

独立KCL数Independent KCL count

n个节点的全部KCL有一条总和为0的依赖关系，故独立方程n−1=4。The n node KCL equations have one sum dependency, leaving n−1=4 independent equations.

NKCL=n−1=5−1=4

独立KVL数Independent KVL count

生成树含n−1=4条边，其余b−(n−1)=4条连支分别生成4个基本回路。A tree has four twigs; the remaining four chords each generate a fundamental loop.

NKVL=b−n+1=8−5+1=4

独立KCL方程4个；独立KVL方程4个。Four independent KCL equations and four independent KVL equations.

易错点Common errors

  • “共有几个节点”与“独立KCL几个”相差1。The independent KCL count is one less than the vertex count.
  • KVL数是独立回路数，不是把所有能画出的回路全数一遍。Count independent loops, not every possible cycle.

核验依据Verification

独立构造原图5×8有向关联矩阵，精确消元秩4，零空间维数8−4=4；与树、连支计数法独立吻合。附录第333页、PDF342页为4、4。Independent exact elimination of the original 5×8 oriented incidence matrix gives rank 4 and nullity 4, matching the tree and chord count. The appendix gives 4,4.

2-6全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第61页／PDF第70页。范围状态：考试范围（图论与基本分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70. Coverage: required: graph theory and basic analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

完整2b方程：3条KCL、3条KVL、6条元件约束Complete 2b system: 3 KCL, 3 KVL, 6 branch laws

题目原文Transcribed question

试列出题图2-4所示电路的2b方程。Write the 2b equations for the circuit in Fig. 2-4.

4节点a顶、b中左、c中右、d底。R1支路a→b，R2支路b→d，R3支路c→d；左us源a正d负，电流i4沿d→a；is1从b→c，is2从c→a。Four nodes a top, b middle-left, c middle-right, d bottom. R1 current a→b, R2b→d, R3c→d. Left us is positive at a relative to d, with i4d→a. Sources is1 go b→c and is2c→a.

本题图在书第61页／PDF第70页。The source figure is on printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

2b法以每条支路的电流、电压为未知；n−1独立KCL、b−n+1独立KVL；各元件约束。The 2b method uses every branch current and voltage; n−1 KCL, b−n+1 KVL and one law per branch.
本图6条支路，所以未知量为6个电流与6个电压。保留原电流方向，补定义各支路电压为沿电流的关联参考方向；尤其左源电流向上，其关联电压u4=−us。There are six branches and twelve unknowns. Preserve original current directions and define each voltage in the passive reference along its current; the upward left-source current then has u4=−us.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

定义12个未知量Define the twelve unknowns

按支路1至6依次为R1、R2、R3、us源、is1源、is2源。i5参考b→c、i6参考c→a；电压依次u1=Va−Vb、u2=Vb−Vd、u3=Vc−Vd、u4=Vd−Va、u5=Vb−Vc、u6=Vc−Va。Branches 1–6 are R1, R2, R3, us, is1 and is2. Define i5b→c and i6c→a. Voltages are Va−Vb, Vb−Vd, Vc−Vd, Vd−Va, Vb−Vc and Vc−Va.

(i1,…,i6, u1,…,u6),b=6,2b=12

三条独立KCLThree independent KCL equations

分别在a、b、c列KCL，d节点的KCL由它们相加得到，不再重复列。Apply KCL at a, b and c. Node d is dependent and is not repeated.

i4+i6−i1=0,i1−i2−i5=0,i5−i3−i6=0

三条独立KVLThree independent KVL equations

取树支1、2、3，以连支4、5、6各生成一个基本回路。按各连支方向绕行，电压相加为0。Choose tree branches 1,2,3 and form one loop per chord 4,5,6. Follow each chord reference for loop traversal.

u4+u1+u2=0,u5+u3−u2=0,u6+u1+u2−u3=0

六条支路元件约束Six branch constitutive equations

三只电阻用欧姆定律；左源关联电压与题给us反向；两个电流源固定各自支路电流。Use Ohm’s law for the resistors, opposite polarity for the left source’s passive voltage and fixed currents for the two current sources.

u1=R1i1,u2=R2i2,u3=R3i3,u4=−us,i5=is1,i6=is2

检查方程数量Check completeness

共3+3+6=12个方程，对应12个未知。电流源电压u5、u6并非0，而是由整个电路决定，必须保留为未知。There are 3+3+6 = 12 equations for twelve unknowns. Current-source voltages u5 and u6 are not zero; the circuit determines them.

取上述支路方向，完整系统为所列3条KCL、3条KVL及6条元件约束，共12个方程。特别u4=−us、i5=is1、i6=is2。With the defined references, the listed 3 KCL, 3 KVL and 6 branch laws form the complete twelve-equation system. In particular u4=−us, i5=is1 and i6=is2.

易错点Common errors

  • u4沿d→a关联定义，所以等于−us；不能忽略原电压源极性。u4 is passively referenced d→a and equals −us.
  • 只列KCL和KVL还不够，2b方程还包括每支路的元件关系。KCL and KVL alone are insufficient; include every branch constitutive relation.
  • 理想电流源固定电流，不固定为零电压。An ideal current source fixes its current, not zero voltage.

核验依据Verification

独立把上述12式组装成12×12有理数系统，3组正电阻及正负源参数均秩12。另按原图独立搭建节点MNA，恢复出的全部6电流、6电压逐项完全相同，∑ukik=0及全电路功率和精确为0。附录未列2-6，完整方程与独立原拓扑检查提供依据。The twelve equations independently form a full-rank 12×12 exact-rational system for three sets of positive resistors and signed sources. Separately stamped original-node MNA reproduces all six currents and six voltages exactly, with ∑ukik=0 and zero full power residual. The appendix omits 2-6; completeness and independent topology checks support the answer.

2-7全书习题Book exercise已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第61页／PDF第70页。范围状态：考试范围（图论与基本分析；课程纲领2.1～2.5）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 61 · PDF p. 70. Coverage: required: graph theory and basic analysis; course plan 2.1–2.5.

支路电流法：两个回路与顶节点KCLBranch-current method: KCL and loop-voltage equality

题目原文Transcribed question

试用支路电流法求解题图2-5所示电路中各支路的电流。Use the branch-current method to find all branch currents in Fig. 2-5.

底部公共。左6V源上正下负，上端经2Ω接顶中节点M，i1从左向M。右4V源上正下负，上端经4Ω接M，i2从右向M。中间1A源由底向上流入M。Bottom is common. A top-positive 6V source connects through 2Ω to middle-top M, with i1 toward M from the left. A top-positive 4V source connects through 4Ω toward M from the right, with i2 toward M. A central 1A source injects upward into M.

本题图在书第62页／PDF第71页。The source figure is on printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

支路电流法；KCL；KVL；负电流的实际方向；电源吸收功率。Branch-current analysis, KCL, KVL, actual directions of negative currents and absorbed source power.
i1、i2都按图流入顶节点，1A源也流入，因此两未知必有负值。先按参考方向列KCL，再用左右路径计算同一顶节点电压，联立两式。Both i1 and i2 are referenced into the top node, as is the 1A source, so negative unknowns are expected. Apply KCL, then equate the middle voltage found from left and right paths.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

顶节点KCLTop-node KCL

三个参考电流均流入M，所以i1+i2+1=0，即i1+i2=−1A。All three reference currents enter M, so i1+i2+1=0.

i1+i2=−1

左右路径KVLKVL through left and right paths

从底部经左6V源和2Ω到M，VM=6−2i1；从右4V源和4Ω到M，VM=4−4i2。相等得2i1−4i2=2。The left path gives VM=6−2i1 and right path VM=4−4i2. Equality gives 2i1−4i2=2.

6−2i1=4−4i2⇒2i1−4i2=2

联立求解并说明全部支路Solve and state all branch directions

解得i1=−13A、i2=−23A。实际从M向左流13A、向右流23A，然后均经各自电压源向下回到底部；中央源仍向上1A。Solving gives i1=−13A and i2=−23A. Actual currents leave M leftward by 13A and rightward by 23A, then pass downward through the voltage sources; the middle source remains 1A upward.

i1=−13A,i2=−23A,is=1A upward

i1=−13A，i2=−23A；实际分别从顶中节点向左13A、向右23A。中央支路为1A向上。i1=−13A and i2=−23A, actually outward from the middle node leftward and rightward. The central branch is 1A upward.

易错点Common errors

  • i2的原箭头向左、指向M，不能当成由M向右。The original i2 arrow points leftward toward M.
  • 负答案应保留，再另述实际方向，不要只取绝对值。Retain negative referenced values and state actual directions separately.

核验依据Verification

独立原图MNA得M=203V，大于左6V与右4V，故实际确从M向两侧流。两电阻共耗散2W，6V源吸收2W、4V源吸收83W，1A源提供203W，功率完全平衡。支路方程和MNA结果一致，附录第333页、PDF342页为−13、−23A。Independent original-topology MNA gives M=203V, above both 6V and 4V, confirming outward actual currents. Resistors dissipate 2W, the voltage sources absorb 2 and 83W, and the current source supplies 203W. Branch equations and MNA agree with the appendix values −13 and −23A.

2-11指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第62页／PDF第71页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2-11Assigned requirement: 2-11

节点法：先列注入电流，再求端口电压差Nodal analysis: injections first, port difference last

题目原文Transcribed question

试用节点电压法求题图2-9所示电路中的电压u。Use nodal-voltage analysis to find voltage u in Fig. 2-9.

底左公共节点接地，15V源上正下负，其上端经3Ω接节点1。节点1经6Ω接地，经2Ω接节点2；另有5A源从节点1指向节点2。节点2经2Ω接节点3，节点3经2Ω接地。输出u按节点2正、节点3负。The lower-left common node is ground. A15V source positive at the top connects through 3Ω to node 1. Node 1 connects to ground through 6Ω and to node 2 through 2Ω, with a5A source also pointing from 1 to 2. Node 2 connects through 2Ω to node 3, which connects through 2Ω to ground. Output u is positive at node 2 and negative at node 3.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

节点电压法；电流源的注入符号；电压等于节点电位差。Nodal analysis, current-source injection signs and voltage as a node-potential difference.
5A在节点1流出、节点2流入，两条方程右端符号相反。输出端负极是节点3，不能直接把节点2电位当输出。The 5A source leaves node 1 and enters node 2, so its injection signs oppose. The output negative terminal is node 3, not ground.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

节点1列KCLKCL at node 1

取节点电压为v1、v2、v3，源上端已知15V。节点1电阻流出电流之和等于−5A。Let node potentials be v1, v2 and v3. The source upper terminal is at 15V. Resistor currents leaving node 1 sum to −5A.

v1−153+v16+v1−v22=−5

节点2、3列KCLKCL at nodes 2 and 3

节点2注入5A，节点3没有外部注入。Node 2 receives 5A; node 3 has no external injection.

v2−v12+v2−v32=5,v3−v22+v32=0

消元求各节点电位Solve node potentials

第一式化为v2=2v1，第三式给v2=2v3；代入第二式，得到v1=v3=5V、v2=10V。The first equation gives v2=2v1 and the third gives v2=2v3. Substitution into the second gives v1=v3=5V and v2=10V.

v1=5V,v2=10V,v3=5V

按输出参考极性取电位差Take the referenced output difference

输出u的正端是2，负端是3。The positive output terminal is 2 and the negative terminal is 3.

u=v2−v3=10−5=5V

u=5V。u=5V.

易错点Common errors

  • 同一个5A源在两个节点的注入符号相反，不能两处都写+5。The same 5A source has opposite injection signs at nodes 1 and 2.
  • 节点3不是地，u=v2−v3，而非v2。Node 3 is not ground: u=v2−v3, not v2.

核验依据Verification

独立源变换复核：节点1左侧15V3Ω与6Ω网络等效为10V串联2Ω；节点1到2的5A∥2Ω变为使节点2升高10V的串联源。外回路总电阻2+2+4=8Ω，电流(10+10)8=2.5A，故节点2为10V、节点3为5V，输出5V。书第333页、PDF342页2-11亦为5V。Independent source-transformation check: the left 15V3Ω and 6Ω network becomes 10V in series with 2Ω. The 5A parallel 2Ω between nodes 1 and 2 becomes a10V rise toward node 2 in series with 2Ω. The loop current is (10+10)(2+2+4)=2.5A, giving node 2 at 10V and node 3 at 5V, hence u=5V. Answer 2-11 on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 agrees.

2-12指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第62页／PDF第71页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 62 · PDF p. 71. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2-12Assigned requirement: 2-12

受控电压源：先读正负端，再写约束Controlled voltage source: polarity before constraints

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图2-10所示电路中的电流i。Find current i in the circuit of Fig. 2-10.

上下为公共节点。左支路4Ω，i参考向上；第二支路为3A向上源；第三支路为电压5i的受控电压源（上负下正）串联2Ω；最右支路12Ω。The upper and lower nodes are common. The left branch is 4Ω with i upward. The next is a3A upward source. The third has a controlled voltage source 5i, negative at the top and positive at the bottom, in series with 2Ω. The right branch is 12Ω.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

节点法；电流控制电压源；控制电流的参考方向。Nodal analysis, current-controlled voltage sources and current reference direction.
全电路只有一个公共上节点电位，但受控源与2Ω之间还要写一个电压约束。i向上，因此i=−v4。There is one common upper-node potential, with an additional constraint at the junction of the controlled source and 2Ω. Since i points upward, i=−v4.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

定义节点并写控制关系Define potentials and the control relation

底节点为0V，上节点为v，受控源下端与2Ω上端连接点为vx。左支路i向上；受控源正端在下方。Set the bottom to 0V, the upper potential to v and the source and resistor junction to vx. Current i is upward, and the controlled source is positive at its lower terminal.

i=−v4,vx−v=5i⇒vx=v+5i

上节点列KCLApply KCL at the upper node

三条非独立电流源支路的向下电流分别为v4、vx2和v12，它们之和等于3A向上注入。The downward currents in the three other branches are v4, vx2 and v12. Their sum equals the 3A upward injection.

v4+v+5i2+v12=3

代入控制关系并求解Substitute and solve

代入i=−v4后，vx=−v4，KCL化为5v24=3。故v=14.4V，i=−3.6A。Substituting i=−v4 gives vx=−v4. KCL becomes 5v24=3, so v=14.4V and i=−3.6A.

v=725=14.4V,i=−185=−3.6A

i=−3.6A，即4Ω支路实际电流3.6A向下。i=−3.6A: the actual current through 4Ω is 3.6A downward.

易错点Common errors

  • 原图受控源上负下正，必须写vx−v=5i，不能写v−vx=5i。The source is negative at the top and positive below: write vx−v=5i, not v−vx=5i.
  • 负的i同时影响受控源电压，不应在代入时去掉负号。The signed current also controls the source voltage; do not discard its negative sign.

核验依据Verification

独立支路与功率核验：vx=−3.6V，中间支路向下电流−1.8A；上节点向下电流3.6−1.8+1.2=3A。电阻耗散51.84+6.48+17.28=75.6W；3A源吸收−43.2W，受控源上到下电压18V、向下电流−1.8A，吸收−32.4W，总和0。书第333页、PDF342页2-12为−3.6A。Independent branch and power check: vx=−3.6V and the middle downward current is −1.8A. Downward currents sum to 3.6−1.8+1.2=3A. Resistor powers total 51.84+6.48+17.28=75.6W. The 3A source absorbs −43.2W; the controlled source has an 18V top-to-bottom drop with −1.8A downward, absorbing −32.4W. Total power is zero. Answer 2-12 on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 is −3.6A.
