2-20指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第63页／PDF第72页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2-20Assigned requirement: 2-20

网孔法遇电流源：超网孔加电流约束A current source in mesh analysis: supermesh plus constraint

题目原文Transcribed question

试用网孔分析法求题图2-18所示电路中的电流i1、i2和i3。Use mesh analysis to find currents i1, i2 and i3 in Fig. 2-18.

底部公共节点，左2V源上负下正，经上方4Ω接顶中节点，4Ω电流i1向右；顶中经5Ω接右30V源上端，i2向右，30V源也上负下正。顶中与底部之间另有2Ω电阻（i3向下）和3A向下电流源两条并联支路。The bottom is common. The left 2V source is negative at the top and connects through upper 4Ω to the middle-top node, with i1 rightward. A5Ω resistor carries i2 rightward from this node to the upper terminal of the right 30V source, also negative at the top. A2Ω resistor with i3 downward and a3A downward current source separately connect middle-top to bottom.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

顺时针网孔电流；共享支路电流差；超网孔。Clockwise mesh currents, differences in shared branches and supermeshes.
电流源位于两个相邻网孔的公共边，其端电压未知，不能写成电阻压降。把这两个网孔合成超网孔，再补电流源约束。The current source lies between adjacent meshes and has an unknown voltage. Form a supermesh around those meshes and add the current constraint.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

定义三个网孔电流Define three mesh currents

从左到右，三个最小网孔取顺时针电流j1、j2、j3。则i1=j1，i2=j3，2Ω中向下电流i3=j1−j2。Take clockwise mesh currents j1, j2 and j3 from left to right. Then i1=j1, i2=j3 and the downward 2Ω current is i3=j1−j2.

i1=j1,i2=j3,i3=j1−j2

左网孔KVLLeft-mesh KVL

左2V源从下向上经过是从正端到负端，为2V压降。Traversing the left 2V source upward goes from positive to negative, producing a2V drop.

2+4j1+2(j1−j2)=0⇒6j1−2j2=−2

中右超网孔与电流约束Middle and right supermesh and current constraint

超网孔绕过3A源，经过5Ω、30V源和2Ω。右30V源从上向下是电压上升。3A向下等于中网孔向下减右网孔向上。The supermesh bypasses the 3A source and passes through 5Ω, the 30V source and 2Ω. Traversing the 30V source downward is a voltage rise. The downward 3A equals the middle mesh current minus the right mesh current.

5j3−30−2(j1−j2)=0,j2−j3=3

联立并还原支路电流Solve and recover branch currents

解得j1=2A、j2=7A、j3=4A。因此i1=2A、i2=4A、i3=−5A；i3实际向上5A。Solving gives j1=2A, j2=7A and j3=4A. Thus i1=2A, i2=4A and i3=−5A; its actual direction is 5A upward.

i1=2A,i2=4A,i3=−5A

i1=2A，i2=4A，i3=−5A（按图示参考方向）。i1=2A, i2=4A and i3=−5A, using the figure reference directions.

易错点Common errors

  • i3是共享支路电流差，不是某一个网孔电流。i3 is a difference of mesh currents, not a single mesh current.
  • 两个电压源均上负下正，绕行时必须逐个判定电压升降。Both voltage sources are negative at the top; determine each voltage rise or drop from the traversal direction.

核验依据Verification

独立节点法：取底部0V，则左端−2V、右端−30V。顶中节点V满足(V+2)4+V2+(V+30)5+3=0，得V=−10V。于是i1=[−2−(−10)]4=2A、i2=[−10−(−30)]5=4A、i3=−102=−5A；KCL也有2=4−5+3。书第333页、PDF342页2-20三项完全相同。Independent nodal check: with bottom at 0V, the left and right upper terminals are −2V and −30V. The middle-top V satisfies (V+2)4+V2+(V+30)5+3=0, giving V=−10V. Then i1=[−2−(−10)]4=2A, i2=[−10−(−30)]5=4A and i3=−102=−5A. KCL gives 2 = 4−5+3. Answer 2-20 on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 matches all three.

2-21指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第63页／PDF第72页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 63 · PDF p. 72. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：2-21Assigned requirement: 2-21

网孔法中的受控电压源与电流源约束Mesh analysis with controlled voltage and current-source constraints

题目原文Transcribed question

试用网孔分析法求题图2-19所示电路中的电流i。Use mesh analysis to find current i in Fig. 2-19.

左、右上节点由顶端导线直接相连，顶导线电流i1向右。中间横支路依次为2Ω和1Ω，中间节点经3A向上的电流源接底节点。左侧10V源、右侧受控电压源2i1均上正下负，接在上节点与底节点间。所求i在左下导线上向左。The upper left and upper right nodes are directly joined by a top wire carrying i1 rightward. A middle path contains 2Ω then 1Ω; their junction connects to the bottom through a3A upward current source. The left 10V source and right controlled voltage source 2i1 are both positive at the top. The requested i points left along the lower-left wire.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

网孔电流与共享支路；超网孔；受控源控制关系。Mesh currents and shared branches, supermeshes, and controlled-source relations.
顶导线压降为0，却仍可能有非零电流。受控源的控制量就是这条导线电流i1；遇到3A源，要加电流差约束而不是给它指定电压。The top wire has zero voltage drop but can carry nonzero current. Its current i1 controls the voltage source. The 3A source supplies a mesh-current difference constraint, not a specified voltage.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

定义网孔与支路电流Define mesh and branch currents

上方、左下、右下三个最小网孔分别取顺时针电流j1、j2、j3。顶导线只有上网孔经过，所以i1=j1；左下导线只有左下网孔经过，所以i=j2。3A向上对应j3−j2。Assign clockwise currents j1, j2 and j3 to the upper, lower-left and lower-right meshes. Only j1 traverses the top wire, so i1=j1. Only j2 traverses the lower-left wire, so i=j2. The upward 3A is j3−j2.

i1=j1,i=j2,j3−j2=3

上网孔列KVLApply KVL to the upper mesh

上网孔顺时针从顶导线到右端，再经1Ω、2Ω返回左端。两段电阻电流均为相邻网孔电流之差。Traverse the upper mesh clockwise along the top wire, then return through 1Ω and 2Ω. Each resistor current is the difference of adjacent mesh currents.

(j1−j3)+2(j1−j2)=0⇒3j1−2j2−j3=0

列下方超网孔Write the lower supermesh equation

绕过3A源，沿左下和右下网孔的外边界：依次经过2Ω、1Ω、受控电压源，再经10V源从负到正。受控源压降必须保留为2j1。Bypass the 3A source and traverse the lower supermesh boundary through 2Ω, 1Ω, the controlled voltage source, then the 10V source from negative to positive. Retain the controlled-source drop as 2j1.

2(j2−j1)+(j3−j1)+2j1−10=0⇒−j1+2j2+j3=10

联立求解Solve the system

将前两条KVL相加可得2j1=10，故j1=5A；再用电流源约束和上网孔方程解得j2=4A、j3=7A。Adding the two KVL equations gives 2j1=10 and j1=5A. Using the current-source constraint and upper-mesh equation then gives j2=4A and j3=7A.

(j1,j2,j3)=(5,4,7)A,i=4A

i=4A，方向与图中向左的参考方向相同。i=4A, in the indicated leftward direction.

易错点Common errors

  • 理想导线电压为0并不意味着电流为0。Zero voltage across an ideal wire does not imply zero current.
  • 受控源不能在写超网孔时去掉；其控制量是顶导线电流，不是所求i。Keep the controlled source in the supermesh. Its control current is the top-wire current, not the requested i.

核验依据Verification

独立节点、功率核验：底节点取0V，左右上节点均为10V；中间节点KCL给出(V−10)2+(V−10)=3，得V=12V。顶导线i1=102=5A，左节点有中间流入1A、顶导线流出5A，所以10V源向上4A，即i=4A。电阻耗散6W；10V源、受控源和3A源吸收功率依次−40、70、−36W，总和0。精确有理数MNA复核相同。书第333页、PDF342页2-21为4A。Independent nodal and power check: set the bottom to 0V. Both upper nodes are 10V; middle-node KCL gives (V−10)2+(V−10)=3, so V=12V. The controlled relation gives i1=102=5A. At the left node, 1A enters from the middle and 5A leaves along the wire; the 10V source therefore supplies 4A upward, equal to i. Resistors dissipate 6W; the 10V, controlled and 3A sources absorb −40, 70 and −36W, totaling zero. Exact-rational MNA agrees. Answer 2-21 on printed p. 333 and PDF p. 342 is 4A.

3-4指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第87页／PDF第96页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3-4Assigned requirement: 3-4

叠加电流，再用总电流计算功率Superpose currents, then use the total current for power

题目原文Transcribed question

利用叠加定理求题图3-4所示电路中的电流i及电流i所在支路电阻消耗的功率。Use superposition to find current i in Fig. 3-4 and the power dissipated by the resistor in its branch.

左4V源上正下负，顶端经2Ω到节点A。A经竖直2Ω接左下节点，i向下；A经顶端10Ω到节点B。B经竖直10Ω接右下节点C，另有4A源从C向上到B。左下节点经2A向右的电流源到C。The left 4V source is positive at the top and connects through 2Ω to node A. A connects through vertical 2Ω to the lower-left node, with i downward, and through upper 10Ω to node B. B connects through vertical 10Ω to lower-right node C, in parallel with a4A source directed from C to B. A2A current source points from the lower-left node to C.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

叠加定理；独立电压源置零短路，独立电流源置零开路；电阻功率。Superposition; short a zeroed independent voltage source and open a zeroed current source; resistor power.
本题有三个独立源，应分别求三个带符号电流贡献。右侧4A源单独作用时，电流只在其并联10Ω支路形成局部回路，对所求i的贡献为0。There are three independent sources, so find three signed current contributions. With only the right 4A source active, its current circulates through the parallel 10Ω resistor and contributes zero to i.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

4V源单独作用The 4V source acting alone

将2A、4A源开路。右侧两只10Ω形成通向悬空节点的支路，无电流。左侧两个2Ω串联，所求支路向下电流为1A。Open the 2A and 4A sources. The right pair of 10Ω resistors leads to a floating node and carries no current. The two left 2Ω resistors are in series, giving 1A downward in the requested branch.

i(4V)=42+2=1A

2A源单独作用The 2A source acting alone

将4V源短路、4A源开路。2A从右侧经两只10Ω流到节点A，再经过左侧两个并联2Ω返回左下节点。两只2Ω均分电流，所求向下电流为1A。Short the 4V source and open the 4A source. The 2A current returns from the right through both 10Ω resistors to A, then through the two parallel left 2Ω resistors. They share equally, giving 1A downward in the requested branch.

i(2A)=222+2=1A

4A源单独作用The 4A source acting alone

将4V源短路、2A源开路。右下节点只连接4A源与其并联10Ω，4A由该10Ω返回。顶端10Ω中无电流，因此所求i的贡献为0。Short the 4V source and open the 2A source. The lower-right node connects only to the 4A source and its parallel 10Ω resistor, which returns all 4A. The upper 10Ω carries no current, so this contribution to i is zero.

i(4A)=0

叠加后计算功率Add currents before calculating power

三个贡献按图示参考方向相加。功率必须由总电流求得，不能把各独立作用下的功率相加。Add the three contributions with their signs. Compute power from the total current; powers for separate source excitations do not superpose.

i=1+1+0=2A,P=i2(2Ω)=8W

i=2A（向下）；该2Ω电阻消耗8W。i=2A downward; the 2Ω resistor dissipates 8W.

易错点Common errors

  • 功率不是源激励的线性函数，12×2+12×2=4W并非正确总功率。Power is nonlinear in source excitation; 12×2+12×2=4W is not the total power.
  • 电流源置零应开路，不是短路。A zeroed ideal current source is an open circuit.

核验依据Verification

独立完整电路节点法：左下取0V，左上4V，设A、B、C为图示节点；右侧KCL给出B−A=20V、C−B=−20V，A点KCL为(A−4)2+A2+(A−B)10=0，得A=4、B=24、C=4V，故i=2A。电阻总耗散88W，2A与4A源分别提供8W、80W，4V源电流0，功率平衡。精确MNA同时复核三个分量为1、1、0A。书第334页、PDF343页3-4为2A、8W。Independent full-circuit nodal check: set the lower-left node to 0V and upper-left to 4V. Right-side KCL gives B−A=20V and C−B=−20V. At A, (A−4)2+A2+(A−B)10=0, yielding A=4, B=24 and C=4V, hence i=2A. Resistors dissipate 88W; the 2A and 4A sources supply 8 and 80W, while the 4V source carries zero current. Exact MNA also verifies the three contributions as 1, 1 and 0A. Answer 3-4 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 2A and 8W.

3-10指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第87页／PDF第96页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 87 · PDF p. 96. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3-10Assigned requirement: 3-10

替代定理：把指定电流的电阻换成电流源Substitution theorem: replace a specified-current resistor by a source

题目原文Transcribed question

电路如题图3-9所示，欲使支路电流I=2A，试用替代定理求电阻R的值。For the circuit in Fig. 3-9, use the substitution theorem to find R such that branch current I=2A.

左12V源上正下负，经上方3Ω到节点A；A经6Ω接底部公共节点。A到节点B之间有1Ω及向右4A源并联。B经3Ω和待求R分别接底部；R中电流I向下。题干在第87页，原图在第88页。The left 12V source is positive at the top and connects through upper 3Ω to A. A connects through 6Ω to the common bottom node. Between A and B are parallel 1Ω and rightward 4A branches. B connects to the bottom through 3Ω and unknown R; I points downward through R. The statement is on printed p. 87 and the figure on p. 88.

本题图在书第88页／PDF第97页。The source figure is on printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

替代定理；节点KCL；欧姆定律。Substitution theorem, nodal KCL and Ohm’s law.
已知R中应通过2A，就用同方向2A理想电流源替代R，先求这条支路需要的端电压，再用R=UI还原。Since R must carry 2A, replace it by a2A source in the same direction. Find the required branch voltage, then recover R=UI.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

替代并定义节点Substitute and define nodes

取底部为0V，左源上端12V。用B向下到地的2A源替代R，设其上端电位为vB，左侧节点为vA。Take the bottom as 0V and the left source top as 12V. Replace R by a2A source directed from B to ground, with upper potential vB. Let the other internal potential be vA.

对A列KCLWrite KCL at A

取离开A为正。包括经3Ω、6Ω、1Ω的电流以及向B流出的4A。Take currents leaving A as positive, including the 3Ω, 6Ω and 1Ω paths and the 4A source toward B.

vA−123+vA6+(vA−vB)+4=0⇒32vA−vB=0

对B列KCL并求电压Write KCL at B and solve for voltage

B处4A流入，替代源2A流出，另外有1Ω和3Ω支路。联立两式得到vA=2V、vB=3V。At B, 4A enters and the substituted 2A leaves, alongside the 1Ω and 3Ω branches. The two equations give vA=2V and vB=3V.

(vB−vA)+vB3+2−4=0⇒−vA+43vB=2

还原电阻Recover the resistance

R的上正下负端电压为3V，向下电流为2A，二者关联，故R为正。R has a3V top-positive voltage and a2A downward current, using passive references, so R is positive.

R=vBI=32Ω=1.5Ω

R=1.5Ω。R=1.5Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 替代支路的方向必须与指定I一致；替代后求出的电压是R的端电压。The substituted source must follow the specified I direction; its resulting voltage is the original resistor voltage.
  • 替代定理不是“将电阻删除”，也不要求改变其他电源。Substitution does not simply delete the resistor or change the other sources.

核验依据Verification

独立回代原电路：将1.5Ω接回后，B=3V时R向下2A，旁路3Ω向下1A，1Ω向左1A，合计4A正好等于源流入；A处(2−12)3+26+(2−3)+4=0。原电路精确有理数MNA也给出A=2、B=3V。电阻共耗散44W，12V源提供40W、4A源提供4W，平衡。书第334页、PDF343页3-10为1.5Ω。Independent original-circuit check: restore 1.5Ω. At B=3V, R carries 2A down, the parallel 3Ω carries 1A down, and the 1Ω carries 1A left, matching the incoming 4A. At A, (2−12)3+26+(2−3)+4=0. Exact-rational MNA of the restored circuit gives A=2 and B=3V. Resistors dissipate 44W; the 12V and 4A sources supply 40 and 4W. Answer 3-10 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 1.5Ω.

3-16指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第88页／PDF第97页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3-16Assigned requirement: 3-16

含受控源的戴维南等效：开路电压加测试源Thévenin equivalent with a controlled source: open circuit plus test source

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图3-15所示单口网络的戴维南等效电路。Find the Thévenin equivalent of the one-port network in Fig. 3-15.

4V独立源上正下负，上端经2Ω到中间节点c；c经竖直2Ω接底节点b，竖直电阻电压U上正下负。c经受控电压源3U到端口a，受控源左负右正。b为端口下端。The 4V independent source is positive at the top and connects through 2Ω to middle node c. A vertical 2Ω joins c to bottom terminal b, with U positive at c. A controlled voltage source 3U connects c to terminal a, negative on the left and positive on the right.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

戴维南等效；开路电压；含受控源网络的外加测试源法。Thévenin equivalent, open-circuit voltage and test-source resistance for controlled-source networks.
受控源右正左负意味着va−U=3U，即端口电压是4U。求等效电阻时只将4V独立源短路，受控源及其控制关系必须保留。The controlled source is positive on the right, so va−U=3U and the port voltage is 4U. For equivalent resistance, short only the independent 4V source and retain the controlled source and its law.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

开路求电压Find the open-circuit voltage

端口a开路，受控源中电流为0。两个2Ω对4V等分，故U=2V；端口电压在此基础上再升高3U。With a open, no current flows through the controlled source. The two 2Ω resistors divide 4V equally, giving U=2V. The port voltage rises by a further 3U.

Uth=U+3U=4(2)=8V

独立源置零，保留受控源Zero the independent source and retain the dependent source

将4V源短路后，中间节点c到b有两个2Ω并联。在a、b间外加上正下负的测试电压Vt，由受控源关系有Vt=4U。After shorting the 4V source, two 2Ω resistors connect c to b in parallel. Apply a top-positive test voltage Vt across a,b. The controlled relation remains Vt=4U.

U=Vt4

求流入网络的测试电流Find test current entering the network

从a流入的测试电流经受控源到c，再通过两个2Ω流出，所以It=U2+U2。The test current entering a passes through the controlled source to c, then through both 2Ω resistors.

It=U2+U2=U=Vt4,Rth=VtIt=4Ω

画出等效关系State the equivalent relation

戴维南电压源8V正端朝a，与4Ω串联。若用从a向外流出的负载电流IL表示端口特性，电压随电流以4Ω的斜率下降。The equivalent is an 8V source, positive toward a, in series with 4Ω. For load current IL leaving a, port voltage falls with slope 4Ω.

vab=8−4IL

戴维南等效：8V电压源（a端正）串联4Ω。Thévenin equivalent: an 8V source, positive toward a, in series with 4Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 受控源不是独立源，求Rth时不能把它短路。A controlled source is not an independent source; do not short it when finding Rth.
  • 受控源极性右正左负，端口电压是U+3U，不是U−3U。The dependent source is positive on the right, making the port voltage U+3U, not U−3U.

核验依据Verification

独立完整端口方程：设I为从a流入网络的电流，c节点KCL为(U−4)2+U2−I=0，得U=2+I，故vab=4U=8+4I；改用流出电流IL=−I，得到8−4IL。另以精确MNA分别检验开路8V、独立源置零后1V测试电压对应14A流入、端口短路电流2A流出，均与Rth=82=4Ω一致。书第334页、PDF343页3-16为8V、4Ω。Independent full port law: let I enter the network at a. KCL at c gives (U−4)2+U2−I=0, hence U=2+I and vab =4U=8+4I. With outward IL=−I, this becomes 8−4IL. Exact MNA separately gives 8V open circuit, 14A entering under a1V test after independent-source suppression, and a2A short-circuit current outward, all consistent with Rth=82=4Ω. Answer 3-16 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 8V and 4Ω.

3-17指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第88页／PDF第97页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3-17Assigned requirement: 3-17

受控源诺顿等效：短路电流与测试电阻Norton equivalent with a controlled source: short-circuit current and test resistance

题目原文Transcribed question

求题图3-16所示单口网络的诺顿等效电路。Find the Norton equivalent of the one-port network in Fig. 3-16.

左20V源上正下负，顶端经2Ω到端口a，2Ω电压u1左正右负。a向下先经上正下负的受控电压源2u1，再经4Ω接底端b。The left 20V source is positive at the top and connects through 2Ω to terminal a. The 2Ω voltage u1 is positive on the left. A downward branch from a contains a controlled voltage source 2u1, positive at the top, followed by 4Ω to bottom terminal b.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

诺顿等效；短路电流；受控源网络测试法。Norton equivalent, short-circuit current and test-source analysis with dependent sources.
端口短路时u1=20V，受控源电压仍为40V，并不会一起变成0。它使4Ω上端为−40V，因此该支路实际向端口提供电流。Shorting the port gives u1=20V, so the controlled source remains at 40V. It places the 4Ω upper terminal at −40V, making this branch supply current toward the port.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

短路求诺顿电流Short the port to find Norton current

将a、b短路，取b为0V，故a也为0V。左2Ω向a送入(20−0)2=10A。受控源2u1=40V，使其下端c为−40V，4Ω中向下电流−10A，即向a再送入10A。Short a,b and set b to 0V, so a is also 0V. The left 2Ω sends (20−0)2=10A into a. The controlled source is 2u1=40V, placing its lower node c at −40V. The downward 4Ω current is −10A, supplying another 10A to a.

Isc=10+10=20A

置零独立源并加测试电压Suppress the independent source and apply test voltage

仅把20V源短路，在端口加Vt。此时u1=−Vt，受控源关系Vt−vc=2u1=−2Vt，故vc=3Vt。Short only the 20V source and apply Vt at the port. Then u1=−Vt and the controlled law is Vt−vc=2u1=−2Vt, so vc=3Vt.

vc=3Vt

求诺顿电阻与方向Find Norton resistance and source direction

流入端口的测试电流分为经2Ω到地与经受控源、4Ω到地两部分。诺顿源方向从b向a，才能使外部短路电流从a流向b。The entering test current splits between the 2Ω path and the controlled-source and 4 Ω path. The Norton source points from b to a, giving an external short-circuit current from a to b.

It=Vt2+3Vt4=54Vt,RN=VtIt=45Ω=0.8Ω

诺顿等效：20A电流源（从b向a）并联0.8Ω。Norton equivalent: a20A source from b to a in parallel with 0.8Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • a、b短路只令端口电压为0，不令受控源的控制电压u1为0。Shorting a,b zeros the port voltage, not the controlling voltage u1.
  • 测试时u1的参考极性左正右负，因此u1=−Vt。During the test, u1 is positive on the left, so u1=−Vt.

核验依据Verification

独立完整端口法：端口电压v时u1=20−v，受控源下节点vc=v−2(20−v)=3v−40。流入网络的电流I=(v−20)2+(3v−40)4=5v4−20，故向外电流为20−v0.8。开路v=16V，1620=0.8Ω。精确MNA以0.8Ω负载检验得v=8V、负载电流10A；总电阻耗散216W，两个源提供216W，功率平衡。书第334页、PDF343页3-17为20A、0.8Ω。Independent full port law: at voltage v, u1=20−v and the lower controlled-source node is vc=v−2(20−v)=3v−40. Entering current is I=(v−20)2+(3v−40)4=5v4−20, so outward current is 20−v0.8. Open circuit gives v=16V and 1620=0.8Ω. Exact MNA with a0.8Ω load gives 8V and 10A; resistors dissipate 216W, exactly supplied by the two sources. Answer 3-17 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 20A and 0.8Ω.

3-19指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第88页／PDF第97页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 88 · PDF p. 97. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3-19Assigned requirement: 3-19

戴维南法：先移开负载，再求端口等效Thévenin method: remove the load before finding the port equivalent

题目原文Transcribed question

应用戴维南定理求题图3-18所示电路中的电流i。Use Thévenin’s theorem to find current i in Fig. 3-18.

底部公共节点。左节点A经1Ω接底部，A到中节点B有24V源，左正右负；B经上正下负的4V源接底部。A到右节点C经顶端5Ω，B到C经2Ω；C经右侧4Ω负载接底部，电流i向下。The bottom is common. Left node A connects through 1Ω to the bottom. A24V source from A to middle node B is positive on the left. B connects through a top-positive 4V source to the bottom. A connects to right node C through upper 5Ω; B connects to C through 2Ω. The right 4Ω load joins C to the bottom, with i downward.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

戴维南定理；开路端口KCL；独立电压源置零短路。Thévenin’s theorem, open-port KCL and suppression of independent voltage sources.
将右侧4Ω视为负载移开。两个理想源先固定B=4V、A=28V，左1Ω只影响源电流，不改变这些节点电位。Remove the right 4Ω load. The ideal sources fix B=4V and A=28V. The left 1Ω affects source currents but cannot change those fixed potentials.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

负载开路求UthRemove the load and find Uth

取底部0V，B=4V，A−B=24V，所以A=28V。设负载开路后C点电位为Uth，对C列KCL。Take the bottom as 0V. Then B=4V and A−B=24V, so A=28V. Let the open-circuit potential at C be Uth and apply KCL.

Uth−285+Uth−42=0⇒Uth=767V

独立源置零求RthSuppress independent sources to find Rth

将24V、4V源均短路，A、B与底节点合并，1Ω被短路。端口C到地只剩5Ω与2Ω并联。Short the 24V and 4V sources. A, B and the bottom merge, bypassing the 1Ω resistor. The port sees only 5Ω in parallel with 2Ω.

Rth=5∥2=107Ω

接回4Ω负载Reconnect the 4Ω load

戴维南源与Rth、负载串联；电压源正端朝C，因此负载电流向下为正。The Thévenin source, Rth and load are in series. The source is positive toward C, giving positive downward load current.

i=UthRth+4=767107+4=2A

i=2A，沿右侧4Ω向下。i=2A downward through the right 4Ω resistor.

易错点Common errors

  • 开路时移去的是右侧4Ω负载，不是中间2Ω。Remove the right 4Ω load, not the middle 2Ω resistor.
  • 24V源左正右负，因此A=B+24，不是B−24。The 24V source is positive on the left, so A=B+24, not B−24.

核验依据Verification

独立直接节点法：接回负载后C满足(C−28)5+(C−4)2+C4=0，得C=8V，i=84=2A。C点流入4A经5Ω，流出2A经2Ω、2A经4Ω，KCL成立。精确MNA同时复核开路767V与接载8V。完整电路电阻耗散888W，24V、4V源分别提供768W、120W，功率平衡。书第334页、PDF343页3-19为2A。Independent direct nodal check: with the load restored, (C−28)5+(C−4)2+C4=0 gives C=8V and i=84=2A. At C, 4A enters through 5Ω and 2A leaves through each of the 2Ω and 4Ω branches. Exact MNA also verifies the open-circuit 767V and loaded 8V. Resistors dissipate 888W, supplied as 768W and 120W by the 24V and 4V sources. Answer 3-19 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 2A.

3-22指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第89页／PDF第98页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3-22Assigned requirement: 3-22

由两次负载读数反推单口网络Identify a one-port from two loaded measurements

题目原文Transcribed question

题图3-21所示电路中，N为线性含源电阻网络。已知当开关S1、S2均打开时，电压表的读数为6V；当开关S1闭合、S2打开时，电压表的读数为4V。试求当开关S1打开、S2闭合时电压表的读数。In Fig. 3-21, N is a linear resistive network containing sources. The voltmeter reads 6V with S1 and S2 both open, and 4V with S1 closed and S2 open. Find its reading with S1 open and S2 closed.

网络N的上下端口外接永久6Ω并联支路；另有4Ω串S1、2Ω串S2两条可切换并联支路。右侧电压表跨接端口，上正下负，按理想电压表处理。Across N are a permanent 6Ω branch, a4Ω branch in series with S1, and a2Ω branch in series with S2. The voltmeter is across the port, positive at the top, and is treated as ideal.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

线性含源单口的戴维南模型；负载并联；电压分配。Thévenin modeling of a linear source-containing one-port, parallel loads and voltage division.
两个开关打开时6Ω仍接在端口，6V不是N的开路电压。用两次“端电压、总负载电流”测量建立U=Uth−RthI，再预测第三种负载。The 6Ω remains connected with both switches open, so 6V is not the open-circuit voltage of N. Use the two voltage and current measurements in U=Uth−RthI, then predict the third load.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

第一状态给出一条端口方程Form the first port equation

S1、S2均打开，负载只有6Ω。理想电压表不取电流，因此N向外供电流66=1A。With both switches open, the only load is 6Ω. The ideal voltmeter draws no current, so N supplies 66=1A.

6=Uth−Rth(1)

第二状态给出另一条方程Form the second port equation

S1闭合、S2打开，负载为6Ω与4Ω并联。端电压4V时总电流46+44=53A。With S1 closed and S2 open, 6Ω and 4Ω are parallel. At 4V, total load current is 46+44=53A.

4=Uth−Rth53

求N的等效参数Identify N’s equivalent parameters

两式相减得到2=(23)Rth，再回代第一式。Subtract the equations to get 2=(23)Rth, then substitute into the first equation.

Rth=3Ω,Uth=9V

预测第三状态Predict the third state

S1打开、S2闭合时负载为6Ω与2Ω并联，即1.5Ω。用戴维南电压分配。With S1 open and S2 closed, the load is 6Ω in parallel with 2Ω, or 1.5Ω. Apply voltage division to the identified Thévenin circuit.

RL=6∥2=1.5Ω,U=91.53+1.5=3V

电压表读数为3V（上正下负）。The voltmeter reads 3V, positive at the top.

易错点Common errors

  • 不可把第一状态误认为开路：6Ω始终接入。Do not treat the first state as an open circuit; the 6Ω is always connected.
  • 第二状态总电流应包含6Ω支路和4Ω支路。The second-state current includes both the 6Ω and 4Ω branches.

核验依据Verification

独立等效检验：也可先将固定6Ω并入N，形成新单口，其开路电压就是6V；接4Ω时降为4V，所以新单口内阻2Ω。再接2Ω得到6×2(2+2)=3V，与前法相同。原N参数9V、3Ω回代两次已知状态分别给6V、4V，第三状态供电流0.5+1.5=2A且9−3×2=3V。精确MNA三种状态均相符。书第334页、PDF343页3-22为3V。Independent equivalent check: include the permanent 6Ω inside an enlarged one-port. Its open-circuit voltage is 6V; attaching 4Ω reduces it to 4V, so its resistance is 2Ω. Attaching 2Ω therefore gives 6×2(2+2)=3V. The original 9V, 3Ω model reproduces the known 6V and 4V states; the third supplies 0.5+1.5=2A and satisfies 9−3×2=3V. Exact MNA verifies all three states. Answer 3-22 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 3V.

3-29指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第89页／PDF第98页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 89 · PDF p. 98. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：3-29Assigned requirement: 3-29

最大功率与受控源：先求真实端口电阻Maximum power with a controlled source: find the actual port resistance

题目原文Transcribed question

试确定题图3-28所示电路中负载电阻RL取何值时可获得最大功率。Determine the load resistance RL that receives maximum power in Fig. 3-28.

左侧15V独立源上正下负，上端经4Ω到节点c，4Ω中控制电流I向右。c经上正下负的受控电压源6I接底部公共节点；c经2Ω到负载上端a，RL从a接到底部。The left 15V independent source is positive at the top and connects through 4Ω to c, with control current I rightward. A controlled voltage source 6I, positive at c, connects c to the bottom. A2Ω resistor joins c to load terminal a, and RL joins a to the bottom.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

最大功率传输定理；含受控源的戴维南等效；测试源法。Maximum-power transfer, Thévenin equivalents with dependent sources and test-source analysis.
受控电压源直接限定中间节点电位，所以从负载看进去并非4Ω与2Ω简单串联。先保留控制关系求Rth，再令正电阻负载RL=Rth。The controlled voltage source fixes the middle-node voltage, so the load does not simply see 4Ω and 2Ω in series. Retain its control law to find Rth, then match the positive load resistance to Rth.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

开路求端口电压Find the open-circuit voltage

移去RL，2Ω中无电流，端口a电位等于c。左回路有4I+6I=15，得到I=1.5A、c点电位6I=9V。Remove RL. No current flows through 2Ω, so a and c have equal potentials. The left loop gives 4I+6I=15, hence I=1.5A and c=6I=9V.

I=154+6=1.5A,Uth=9V

独立源置零，求测试电阻Suppress the independent source and find test resistance

只把15V源短路，保留6I受控源。设c点电位为vc，则I=(0−vc)4，同时vc=6I。两式只能给vc=0，因此外加端口测试电压全部落在2Ω上。Short only the 15V source and retain the 6I source. If c is at vc, I=(0−vc)4 while vc=6I. These force vc=0, so an applied port test voltage falls entirely across 2Ω.

vc=6−vc4⇒vc=0,It=Vt2,Rth=2Ω

使用最大功率条件Apply the maximum-power condition

等效内阻为正，电阻负载在RL=Rth时获得最大功率。题目只要求负载值；最大功率可作为额外核验。The equivalent resistance is positive, so the resistive load receives maximum power at RL=Rth. The question asks only for RL; the maximum power is a supplementary check.

RL=Rth=2Ω,Pmax=Uth24Rth=818W

RL=2Ω时获得最大功率。Maximum power occurs at RL=2Ω.

易错点Common errors

  • 求内阻时不能将受控源置零，也不能直接写4+2=6Ω。Do not suppress the controlled source or assume a resistance of 4+2=6Ω.
  • 控制电流I仍按图示从左向右，独立源置零后I=−vc4，负号不能漏。The control current remains referenced left to right, so after source suppression I=−vc4.

核验依据Verification

独立完整负载关系：无论RL取何正值，左回路仍给c=9V，所以PL=81RL(RL+2)2，导数为81(2−RL)(RL+2)3；RL<2时为正，RL>2时为负，唯一最大值在2Ω。此时负载电压4.5V、电流2.25A、功率818W。精确MNA在该负载与多个邻近负载上复核，并检验完整功率平衡：4Ω、2Ω、负载耗散9+10.125+10.125W，两源提供22.5+6.75W，合计0。书第334页、PDF343页3-29为2Ω。Independent full load law: for every positive RL, the left loop still fixes c=9V, so PL=81RL(RL+2)2. Its derivative is 81(2−RL)(RL+2)3, positive below 2 and negative above 2, giving the unique maximum at 2Ω. The load then has 4.5V, 2.25A and 818W. Exact MNA verifies this load and several neighboring values, plus full power balance: the 4Ω, 2Ω and load dissipate 9+10.125+10.125W, supplied as 22.5+6.75W by the sources. Answer 3-29 on printed p. 334 and PDF p. 343 is 2Ω.

5-7指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第140页／PDF第149页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 140 · PDF p. 149. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5-7Assigned requirement: 5-7

电容网络分压：先串并联，再回到每只电容Capacitor voltage division: reduce, then recover each voltage

题目原文Transcribed question

试求题图5-5所示电路中各电容上的电压，已知ab端的电压为uab=12V。Find the voltage across each capacitor in Fig. 5-5, given uab=12V.

C1=12μF接a、c；C2=3μF接c、b；C3=4μF接c、d；C4=12μF接d、b。下方b为公共节点。题干在印刷页140，原图在页141。C1=12μF lies between a,c; C2=3μF between c,b; C3=4μF between c,d; and C4=12μF between d,b. Terminal b is the common bottom node. The statement is on printed p. 140 and figure on p. 141.

本题图在书第141页／PDF第150页。The source figure is on printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

电容串并联；串联电荷相等；uxy=vx−vy。Series and parallel capacitors, equal series charge and uxy=vx−vy.
先看节点：C3与C4串联，再与C2并联，最后与C1串联。按本题通常约定，中间浮置导体初始净电荷为0；如果预先存有任意净电荷，仅给端电压不能唯一确定各电压。Read the nodes: C3 and C4 are series, their equivalent is parallel with C2, and that group is series with C1. Use the exercise’s usual assumption of zero initial net charge on floating internal conductors; arbitrary trapped net charge would require additional initial data.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

逐级求等效电容Reduce the capacitor network

C3与C4串联得3μF，与C2并联后c、b间为6μF。它再与C1的12μF串联。C3 and C4 in series give 3μF; in parallel with C2 this gives 6μF between c,b. This is in series with C1=12μF.

C34=4·124+12=3μF,Ccb=3+3=6μF,Cab=12·612+6=4μF

求第一层分压Find the first voltage division

串联组电荷Q=Cab×12V=48μC，因此C1电压为4V，c、b间电压为8V。C2直接跨接c、b。The series charge is Q=Cab×12V=48μC. Thus C1 has 4V and the c,b group has 8V. C2 is directly across c,b.

uac=4812=4V,ucb=486=8V

求C3、C4各自分压Recover C3 and C4 voltages

C3、C4串联组跨接8V，其电荷Q34=3μF×8V=24μC。电容越小，在相同电荷下电压越大。The C3,C4 series pair is across 8V, with charge Q34=3μF×8V=24μC. The smaller capacitance has the larger voltage for equal charge.

ucd=244=6V,udb=2412=2V

C1：uac=4V；C2：ucb=8V；C3：ucd=6V；C4：udb=2V，均按下标顺序取正端、负端。C1: uac=4V; C2: ucb=8V; C3: ucd=6V; C4: udb=2V. Each subscript order defines the positive and negative terminals.

易错点Common errors

  • 串联电容按电容量倒数分压，不按容量大小正比分压。Series capacitor voltages vary inversely with capacitance.
  • C1电荷48μC不等于C3的24μC；中间并联支路会分配电荷。C1 carries 48μC while C3 carries 24μC; charge splits between the middle parallel branches.

核验依据Verification

采用本章串并联电容的通常条件：各内部孤立导体原先净电荷为0（例如所有电容由未充电状态接入）。如果内部导体预先带有未知净电荷，仅给uab不足以唯一决定四个电压。Use the usual condition for the chapter’s series and parallel capacitor model: each internal isolated conductor initially has zero net charge, as when all capacitors are connected uncharged. If unknown trapped charges are present, uab alone does not determine the four voltages uniquely.

独立节点电荷核验：取b=0、a=12V，则c=8、d=2V。c导体净电荷12(8−12)+3×8+4(8−2)=0μC；d导体净电荷4(2−8)+12×2=0μC。总储能为288μJ，与等效4μF在12V下的½CU2相同。书第335页、PDF344页5-7四个电压完全一致。Independent node-charge check: set b=0 and a=12V, giving c=8 and d=2V. The c conductor has net charge 12(8−12)+3×8+4(8−2)=0μC; d has 4(2−8)+12×2=0μC. Total energy is 288μJ, equal to ½CU2 for the 4μF equivalent at 12V. All four voltages match answer 5-7 on printed p. 335 and PDF p. 344.

5-11指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第141页／PDF第150页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5-11Assigned requirement: 5-11

换路初始值：同时保留电容电压与电感电流Switching initial values: retain capacitor voltage and inductor current

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-7所示电路原已处于稳态，在t=0时刻开关S打开，求i(0+)。The circuit in Fig. 5-7 is initially in steady state. Switch S opens at t=0. Find i(0+).

左4A向上电流源与5Ω并联，其上节点经开关S连接1F电容上端。电容下端接底部公共节点。电容上端经另一5Ω到右节点，i向右。右节点经0.5H电感和3Ω分别接底部，两者并联。A4A upward source is parallel with left 5Ω. Their upper node connects through S to the upper terminal of a1F capacitor; its lower terminal is common bottom. Another 5Ω connects capacitor top to the right node, with i rightward. The right node connects to bottom through parallel 0.5H and 3Ω branches.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

直流稳态电容开路、电感短路；换路定则；瞬时节点KCL。Open capacitors and short inductors in DC steady state, switching continuity and instantaneous KCL.
题目只求0+瞬间，无需求整个LC暂态。先求0−的uC、iL，再在换路后的电路用同值电压源、电流源表示这两个初始状态。Only the instant 0+ is requested, so the complete LC transient is unnecessary. Find uC and iL at 0−, then impose those states on the post-switch circuit.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求换路前的状态Find the pre-switch state

S原来闭合。稳态时1F开路、0.5H短路，右节点为0V，3Ω无电流。两只5Ω从电流源上节点看去并联，4A均分。S is initially closed. In steady state, the capacitor is open and inductor shorted. The right node is 0V and 3Ω carries no current. The two 5Ω branches are parallel and share 4A equally.

uC(0−)=4(5∥5)=10V,iL(0−)=2A

施加换路定则Apply continuity at switching

开关打开只断开左侧激励。没有冲激激励，故电容电压仍10V、电感电流仍向下2A。Opening S disconnects the left excitation. With no impulsive excitation, capacitor voltage remains 10V and downward inductor current remains 2A.

uC(0+)=10V,iL(0+)=2A

用右节点KCL求电流Use right-node KCL

设右节点瞬时电压v。左边5Ω送入(10−v)5，右侧3Ω与电感流出v3+2。解得v=0，因此所求电流2A。Let the instantaneous right-node voltage be v. The 5Ω supplies (10−v)5, while the 3Ω and inductor draw v3+2. This gives v=0 and the requested current 2A.

10−v5=v3+2⇒v=0,i(0+)=105=2A

i(0+)=2A，方向向右。i(0+)=2A rightward.

易错点Common errors

  • 电容电流和电感电压可以突变；保持连续的是uC和iL。Capacitor current and inductor voltage may jump; uC and iL are the continuous states.
  • 换路后电感不能笼统当短路，必须先用其已知初始电流列方程。本题得到0+电压恰好为0，是计算结果。Do not automatically short the inductor after switching. Impose its initial current; its zero voltage at 0+ is a result here.

核验依据Verification

独立约束检查：0−电流源KCL为105+105=4A；0+右节点KCL为2=2+0，电容电压、电感电流均满足连续性。换路瞬间总储能为½×1×102+½×0.5×22=51J，切换前后相同，没有状态跳变所需的冲激能量。书第335页、PDF344页5-11为2A。Independent constraints: before switching, source-node KCL is 105+105=4A; afterward, right-node KCL is 2 = 2+0 and both states are continuous. Stored energy is ½×1×102+ ½×0.5×22=51J on both sides of switching. Answer 5-11 on printed p. 335 and PDF p. 344 is 2A.

5-15指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第141页／PDF第150页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 141 · PDF p. 150. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5-15Assigned requirement: 5-15

受控源初始充电与断开后的RC放电Controlled-source charging and RC discharge after opening

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-11所示电路在开关S打开前已达稳态，t=0时刻开关打开，求开关打开后的电容电压uC(t)。The circuit in Fig. 5-11 is in steady state before switch S opens at t=0. Find the capacitor voltage uC(t) after opening.

左10V源上正下负，向上参考电流i，经S和5kΩ到节点x。x经上正下负的受控电压源104i接底部，并经20kΩ到2μF电容上端。电容下端接底部，uC上正下负。原图明确标20kΩ与2μF。The left 10V source is positive at the top, with upward current i, and connects through S and 5kΩ to node x. A top-positive controlled voltage source 104i joins x to bottom. A20kΩ resistor connects x to the top of a2μF capacitor, with uC top-positive. The original figure explicitly labels 20kΩ and 2μF.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

受控源关系；电容电压连续性；RC零输入响应；单位换算。Controlled-source relations, capacitor-voltage continuity, RC zero-input response and unit conversion.
先用闭合时的受控关系求初始充电电压。打开后控制电流i因断路而为0，所以受控源电压成为0，电容仅经20kΩ放电。这里源变为0是控制量计算结果。First find the initial charge using the closed-switch control law. After opening, i is zero because its branch is broken; the controlled voltage becomes zero and the capacitor discharges through 20kΩ. The dependent source becomes zero as a consequence of its control current.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

换路前求电容电压Find the pre-switch capacitor voltage

稳态电容开路，20kΩ无电流，因此uC(0−)=vx。由左回路和受控源可得i=(10−vx)5000、vx=10000i。In steady state, the capacitor is open and 20kΩ carries no current, so uC(0−)=vx. The left loop and source law give i=(10−vx)5000 and vx=10000i.

vx=2(10−vx)⇒uC(0−)=203V

换路后的三要素Find the three post-switch parameters

电容电压连续；开关打开后i=0，vx=0，最终电压0。电容看入电阻为20kΩ，时间常数须将μF化为10−6F。Capacitor voltage is continuous. After opening, i=0 and vx=0; the final voltage is zero. The capacitor sees 20kΩ. Convert μF to 10−6F when calculating the time constant.

uC(0+)=203V,uC(∞)=0,τ=20000(2×10−6)=0.04s

写出正确响应并核对附录State the response and compare the appendix

因此衰减系数为1τ=25s−1。原书附录写6.67e−2·5t，按本题原图参数指数小了10倍；这里采用满足原电路方程的25s−1，并明确保留此差异。The decay rate is 1τ=25s−1. The printed appendix gives 6.67e−2.5t, whose exponent is ten times too small for the supplied figure. Use 25s−1, which satisfies the original circuit equation, and retain the discrepancy explicitly.

uC(t)=203e−25tV,t≥0

uC(t)=(203)e−25tV，t≥0，t以秒计。附录的−2.5t与原图参数不符。uC(t)=(203)e−25tV for t≥0 in seconds. The appendix exponent −2.5t is inconsistent with the figure parameters.

易错点Common errors

  • 20kΩ×2μF=0.04s，不是0.4s。20kΩ×2μF=0.04s, not 0.4s.
  • 不得为了匹配附录而改读原图的电容或电阻值。Do not reinterpret the figure values just to match the appendix.

核验依据Verification

独立微分方程核验：2×10−6duCdt+uC20000=0，代入e−25t时两项严格抵消，代入e−2·5t则不成立。储能核验：初始½C(203)2=122500J，积分∫0∞uC220000dt恰为同值，且最终电压0。原图20kΩ、2μF及附录第335页、PDF344页的−2.5t已分别放大目视确认。附录初值6.67是203的舍入，但指数存在实质不一致。Independent ODE check: 2×10−6duCdt+uC20000=0. Substitution of e−25t cancels exactly, while e−2.5t does not. Energy check: the initial ½C(203)2 is 122500J, exactly equal to ∫0∞uC220000dt; final voltage is zero. The figure’s20kΩ and 2μF and the appendix exponent −2.5t on printed p. 335 and PDF p. 344 were each visually enlarged and checked. Its 6.67 initial value is ordinary rounding, but the exponent is materially inconsistent.

5-24指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第142页／PDF第151页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 142 · PDF p. 151. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5-24Assigned requirement: 5-24

三种初态下的零输入、零状态与全响应Zero-input, zero-state and full responses for three initial states

题目原文Transcribed question

对题图5-20所示电路。 (1) 若Us=18V，uC(0−)=−6V，求电容电压的零输入响应、零状态响应和全响应。 (2) 若Us=18V，uC(0−)=−12V，求全响应uC(t)。 (3) 若Us=36V，uC(0−)=−6V，求全响应uC(t)。For the circuit in Fig. 5-20: (1) With Us=18V and uC(0−)=−6V, find the zero-input, zero-state and full capacitor-voltage responses. (2) With Us=18V and uC(0−)=−12V, find the full uC(t). (3) With Us=36V and uC(0−)=−6V, find the full uC(t).

Us独立源上正下负，上端经6Ω到电容上节点；该节点经3Ω与14F电容分别接底部公共节点。uC上正下负。The top-positive Us source connects through 6Ω to the capacitor’s top node. Parallel 3Ω and 14F branches connect this node to common bottom. uC is positive at the top.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

RC三要素法；零输入响应保留初态；零状态响应初态为0；线性叠加。The three-parameter RC method, retained initial state for zero-input response, zero initial state for zero-state response, and linear superposition.
三问拓扑相同，所以时间常数相同。源大小决定最终值，电容初态决定指数项幅度。第一问先把两个响应写清，再叠加。All three parts share the topology and time constant. The source fixes the final value, while the capacitor initial state fixes the exponential amplitude. In part (1), write both component responses before adding them.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

统一求时间常数和最终值Find the common time constant and final value

独立源置零后，电容看到6Ω与3Ω并联为2Ω。稳态电容开路，3Ω分得源电压的13。With the independent source suppressed, the capacitor sees 6Ω parallel with 3Ω, or 2Ω. In steady state the capacitor is open, and 3Ω receives one third of the source voltage.

τ=(6∥3)14=12s,uC(∞)=Us3

第一问分别写两个分量Write both components in part (1)

零输入时仅保留−6V初态；零状态时源18V有效、初态0，最终值6V。相加后初态为−6V、最终值6V。The zero-input response retains only the −6V initial state. The zero-state response uses the 18V source and zero initial state, approaching 6V. Their sum starts at −6V and approaches 6V.

uzi=−6e−2t,uzs=6(1−e−2t),uC=6−12e−2t(V)

第二问改变初态Change the initial state in part (2)

最终值仍6V，初态改为−12V，所以指数项系数为−12−6=−18V。The final value remains 6V, but the initial value is −12V. The exponential amplitude is −12−6=−18V.

uC(2)(t)=6−18e−2t(V)

第三问改变激励Change the source in part (3)

源36V使最终值变为12V，初态仍−6V，指数项系数为−6−12=−18V。全部公式适用于t≥0且t以秒计。The 36V source makes the final value 12V. The initial value remains −6V, giving amplitude −6−12=−18V. All formulas apply for t≥0 in seconds.

uC(3)(t)=12−18e−2t(V)

(1) 零输入−6e−2tV；零状态6(1−e−2t)V；全响应6−12e−2tV。 (2)6−18e−2tV。 (3)12−18e−2tV。(1) Zero input: −6e−2tV; zero state: 6(1−e−2t)V; full: 6−12e−2tV. (2)6−18e−2tV. (3)12−18e−2tV.

易错点Common errors

  • 三问初始电压都有负号；第二问是−12V，不是+12V。The initial voltages are signed; part (2) has −12V, not +12V.
  • 时间常数用源置零后的6Ω∥3Ω，不是6+3。Use 6Ω∥3Ω after source suppression, not 6+3Ω, for the time constant.

核验依据Verification

独立原电路方程为¼duCdt+(uC−Us)6+uC3=0，即duCdt+2uC=(23)Us。逐一代入三个全响应，常数项和指数项残差均严格为0；初始值分别−6、−12、−6V，最终值分别6、6、12V，初始斜率分别24、36、36Vs。第一问零输入储能4.5J，恰等于在等效2Ω中的总耗散。书第336页、PDF345页5-24全部小问一致。The independent original-circuit equation is ¼duCdt+(uC−Us)6+uC3=0, or duCdt+2uC=(23)Us. Each full response gives exactly zero constant and exponential residuals. Their initial values are −6, −12 and −6V; final values 6, 6 and 12V; initial slopes 24, 36 and 36Vs. The part (1) zero-input energy is 4.5J, equal to the total loss in equivalent 2Ω. Every part matches answer 5-24 on printed p. 336 and PDF p. 345.

5-27指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第143页／PDF第152页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 143 · PDF p. 152. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5-27Assigned requirement: 5-27

理想电压源将RL与RC暂态分开An ideal voltage source separates RL and RC transients

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-23所示电路在开关S闭合前已经达到稳态，t=0时刻开关闭合，求开关闭合后的电流i(t)。The circuit in Fig. 5-23 reaches steady state before S closes at t=0. Find current i(t) after closing.

左支路为25V源上正下负，向上经5Ω、再经顶端0.5H电感到节点A。A经顶端10Ω到右节点B，B经竖直10Ω接地；B还经0.2F电容及上正下负40V源串联接地。S闭合后把A接到上正下负10V源上端，所求i(t)沿S和10V源向下。The left top-positive 25V source connects upward through 5Ω and then upper 0.5H to node A. A connects through upper 10Ω to B, which connects through vertical 10Ω to ground. Another B−to-ground branch contains a0.2F capacitor followed by a top-positive 40V source. Closing S connects A to the top of a top-positive 10V source. Requested i(t) flows down through S and that 10V source.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

直流稳态；电感电流、电容电压连续；分别求RL、RC响应；节点KCL。DC steady state, inductor-current and capacitor-voltage continuity, separate RL and RC responses and nodal KCL.
开关闭合后A被理想10V源固定为10V，使左右动态支路各自成为一阶电路。先分别求电感流入A的电流和A流向右侧的电流，再相减得到开关支路电流。After closing, the ideal 10V source fixes A at 10V, making the left and right dynamic branches independently first order. Find current entering A from the inductor and current leaving A to the right, then subtract.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

求换路前的两个状态Find both pre-switch states

S打开稳态时电感短路、电容开路。25V通过5Ω、10Ω、10Ω串联，电流1A，故A=20V、B=10V。电容下端是40V，所以上正下负电容电压为−30V。With S open in steady state, short the inductor and open the capacitor. The 25V source drives 1A through series 5Ω, 10Ω and 10Ω, giving A=20V and B=10V. The capacitor lower terminal is at 40V, so its top-positive voltage is −30V.

iL(0+)=1A,uC(0+)=−30V,vB(0+)=10V

求左RL支路Solve the left RL branch

取电感电流由左向右流入A。换路后A=10V，25V与10V之差15V作用在5Ω、0.5H上。最终电流3A，时间常数0.1s。Reference inductor current leftward-to-right into A. With A=10V, 15V drives 5Ω and 0.5H. The final current is 3A and time constant 0.1s.

τL=0.55=0.1s,iL(t)=3−2e−10t(A)

求右RC节点电压Solve the right RC node voltage

稳态时B在两个10Ω间分得5V，初值10V；电容看入电阻10Ω∥10Ω=5Ω，时间常数5×0.2=1s。40V下端源为恒定值，所以B与电容电压具有相同时间常数。B approaches 5V from its 10V initial value through the two 10Ω resistors. The capacitor sees 10Ω∥10Ω=5Ω, giving τ=5×0.2=1s. Its lower terminal remains at 40V, so B and capacitor voltage share this time constant.

vB(t)=5+5e−t,iright(t)=10−vB10=0.5−0.5e−t

由节点KCL还原所求电流Recover the requested current by KCL

A点流入电感电流，流出右支路与向下i。因此所求i等于左电流减右电流。At A, inductor current enters, while right-branch current and downward i leave. Hence i is left current minus right current.

i(t)=iL−iright=2.5−2e−10t+0.5e−t(A),t≥0

i(t)=2.5−2e−10t+0.5e−tA，t≥0，按图向下为正。i(t)=2.5−2e−10t+0.5e−tA for t≥0, with downward positive.

易错点Common errors

  • 电容初始电压是10−40=−30V，不是节点B的10V。Initial capacitor voltage is 10−40=−30V, not B’s10V.
  • 所求i不是电感电流；必须扣除流向右侧的电流。The requested i is not the inductor current; subtract current going right.

核验依据Verification

独立原支路方程：0.5diLdt+5iL=15，和(B−10)10+B10+0.2d(B−40)dt=0，代入两个响应严格成立；节点A的i=iL−(10−B)10给出同式。初值i(0+)=1A、最终i(∞)=2.5A。另将所有电阻耗散、25V10V40V源吸收功率及电感电容储能变化率按指数系数精确相加，恒等于0。书第336页、PDF345页5-27一致。Independent branch equations are 0.5diLdt+5iL=15 and (B−10)10+B10+0.2d(B−40)dt=0. Both responses satisfy them exactly, and A−node KCL i=iL−(10−B)10 reproduces the result. Initial i(0+) is 1A and final i is 2.5A. An exact exponential-coefficient audit also sums all resistor losses, absorbed source powers and storage-energy rates to zero for every t. Answer 5-27 on printed p. 336 and PDF p. 345 agrees.

5-29指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第143页／PDF第152页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 143 · PDF p. 152. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5-29Assigned requirement: 5-29

二次换路：第二段从实际换路值重新开始Two switching events: restart from the actual second-switch state

题目原文Transcribed question

题图5-25所示电路中，开关S原来处于端钮1时，电路已经达到稳态，t=0时刻开关S从端钮1接到端钮2，t=2s时刻开关S又从端钮2接到端钮1，求t≥0时的u(t)。In Fig. 5-25, the circuit is initially in steady state with S at terminal 1. At t=0, S moves from 1 to 2; at t=2s, it returns from 2 to 1. Find u(t) for t≥0.

左5mA电流源向上注入节点A，A经顶端2kΩ到输出节点B。A另经2kΩ到开关端钮1；B另经1kΩ到端钮2，开关公共端接底部地。B经50μF电容再经上正下负3V源接地。电容电压uC上正下负，输出u从B到地上正下负，所以u=uC+3V。A5mA upward source injects node A. Upper 2kΩ joins A to output B. A also connects through 2kΩ to switch terminal 1; B through 1kΩ to terminal 2. The switch common is grounded. B connects to ground through a50μF capacitor followed by a top-positive 3V source. Capacitor voltage uC and output u are top-positive, with u=uC+3V.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

分段一阶响应；电容电压连续；每次换路重新求时间常数与最终值。Piecewise first-order responses, capacitor-voltage continuity and new final values and time constants at each switch.
输出u不是单独的电容电压，但3V恒定，所以它也连续。第二段必须从第一段在2s的实际值开始，并将时间原点移到2s。Output u is not the capacitor voltage alone, but its 3V offset is constant, so u is continuous too. Start the second segment from the actual first-segment value at 2s and shift its time origin to 2s.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

初始稳态Initial steady state

S在1时，电容开路，顶端2kΩ无电流，5mA全流过左竖直2kΩ，所以A、B均为10V。电容初始电压为10−3=7V。With S at 1 and the capacitor open in steady state, upper 2kΩ carries no current. All 5mA flows through the left vertical 2kΩ, giving A=B=10V. Initial capacitor voltage is 10−3=7V.

u(0−)=u(0+)=10V

第一段：S在2First segment: S at 2

此时左竖直2kΩ下端悬空，电流源通过顶端2kΩ向B送入5mA。最终u=5mA×1kΩ=5V。源置零开路后电容看到1kΩ，故τ1=0.05s。The left vertical 2kΩ ends open. The source sends 5mA through upper 2kΩ into B. Final u is 5mA×1kΩ=5V. Opening the zeroed current source leaves a1kΩ resistance seen by the capacitor, so τ1=0.05s.

u(t)=5+5e−20t(V),0≤t≤2

精确保留2s的状态Retain the exact state at 2s

两秒相当于40个时间常数，虽已极接近5V，严格初值仍为5+5e−40V。电容电压与输出在换路时都连续。Two seconds is 40 time constants, so u is extremely close to 5V, but exactly 5+5e−40V. Both capacitor voltage and output remain continuous at switching.

u(2+)=u(2−)=5+5e−40(V)

第二段：S回到1Second segment: S returns to 1

最终u回到10V。源置零后电容经顶端2kΩ和左竖直2kΩ串联放电，τ2=4kΩ×50μF=0.2s。以t−2为新时间变量，从精确换路值出发。The final output returns to 10V. After source suppression, the capacitor sees upper 2kΩ in series with left vertical 2kΩ, giving τ2=4kΩ×50μF=0.2s. Use t−2 and the exact switching value.

u(t)=10−5(1−e−40)e−5(t−2)(V),t>2

说明书后近似式Explain the appendix approximation

书后第二段写10−5e−5(t−2)V，相当于把e−40舍去。它在工程精度下足够准确，但这里保留小项以严格满足连续性。The appendix writes 10−5e−5(t−2)V for the second segment, dropping e−40. This is excellent numerically, but the retained term enforces exact continuity.

5e−40≈2.12×10−17V

0≤t≤2s：u=5+5e−20tV。 t>2s：u=10−5(1−e−40)e−5(t−2)V。 第二段可近似为书后答案10−5e−5(t−2)V。For 0≤t≤2s: u=5+5e−20tV. For t>2s: u=10−5(1−e−40)e−5(t−2)V. The appendix’s second segment, 10−5e−5(t−2)V, is the approximation dropping the tiny residual.

易错点Common errors

  • 第二段指数是t−2，不是t；时间常数从0.05s变为0.2s。The second exponent uses t−2, not t; the time constant changes from 0.05s to 0.2s.
  • 不能把输出u与电容电压uC混用；二者相差恒定3V。Do not confuse output u with capacitor voltage uC; they differ by a constant 3V.

核验依据Verification

独立原方程：第一段50μFdudt+u1000=5mA；第二段50μFdudt+(u−10)4000=0。两个分段式逐项代入残差均为0，2s左右极限均为5+5e−40V，最终u=10V。对应电容电压从7V趋向2V，再趋向7V。书第336页、PDF345页5-29第一段完全一致；第二段是舍去5e−40V残余的近似，相差最大约2.12×10−17V，并非第二次换路可令电容跳变。Independent equations: the first segment satisfies 50μFdudt+u1000=5mA; the second satisfies 50μFdudt+(u−10)4000=0. Both residuals vanish identically, both limits at 2s equal 5+5e−40V, and the final output is 10V. Capacitor voltage goes from 7V toward 2V, then toward 7V. Answer 5-29 on printed p. 336 and PDF p. 345 matches the first segment exactly; its second is the approximation dropping the residual 5e−40V, with maximum difference about 2.12×10−17V. Switching does not permit a capacitor-voltage jump.

5-31指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第143页／PDF第152页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 143 · PDF p. 152. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：5-31Assigned requirement: 5-31

阶跃波形：由跳变时刻与方向写函数Step waveforms: encode transition time and direction

题目原文Transcribed question

用单位阶跃函数表示题图5-27所示的3个电压波形。Express the three voltage waveforms in Fig. 5-27 using the unit-step function.

(a)u1在t<1s时为0，在t>1s时为5V；(b)u2在t<−1s时为0，在t>−1s时为5V；(c)u3在t<1s时为5V，在t>1s时为0。图中跳变点单点取值未指定。(a)u1 is 0 for t<1s and 5V for t>1s. (b)u2 is 0 for t<−1s and 5V for t>−1s. (c)u3 is 5V for t<1s and 0 for t>1s. Values exactly at the jumps are unspecified.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

单位阶跃ϵ(t)；平移；时间反向；下降阶跃。The unit step ϵ(t), time translation, time reversal and falling steps.
把“什么时候跳、跳多大、向上还是向下”分开判断。ϵ(t−t0)在t0后开启；ϵ(t0−t)在t0前开启。Identify when the jump occurs, its size and its direction separately. ϵ(t−t0) is on after t0; ϵ(t0−t) is on before t0.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

(a) 延迟1s的上升阶跃(a) Rising step delayed by 1s

t−1在1s前为负、1s后为正，因此乘5V得到图(a)。t−1 is negative before 1s and positive afterward; multiplying by 5V gives waveform (a).

u1(t)=5ε(t−1)V

(b) 提前1s的上升阶跃(b) Rising step advanced by 1s

跳变在−1s，所以函数参数为t−(−1)=t+1。The jump is at −1s, so the argument is t−(−1)=t+1.

u2(t)=5ε(t+1)V

(c)1s后的下降阶跃(c) Falling step at 1s

在1s前应开启、之后关闭，因此使用反向参数1−t；也可写5[1−ϵ(t−1)]，但跳点取值须使用一致约定。It must be on before 1s and off afterward, so use 1−t. One can also write 5[1−ϵ(t−1)], with a consistent convention at the jump.

u3(t)=5ε(1−t)V

(a)5ϵ(t−1)V；(b)5ϵ(t+1)V；(c)5ϵ(1−t)V。(a)5ϵ(t−1)V; (b)5ϵ(t+1)V; (c)5ϵ(1−t)V.

易错点Common errors

  • 提前到−1s的阶跃是t+1，不是t−1。A step advanced to −1s uses t+1, not t−1.
  • 下降阶跃需要反向或相减，不能直接再用正的5ϵ(t−1)。A falling step requires reversal or subtraction, not another positive 5ϵ(t−1).

核验依据Verification

独立区间取值核验：在t=−2、0、2s代入三式，依次得到(0,0,5)、(0,5,5)、(5,5,0) V，与图的左右平台一致；跳变量分别+5、+5、−5V。图未规定跳点取值，采用同一ϵ(0)约定即可。书第336页、PDF345页5-31三式一致。Independent interval checks: at t=−2, 0 and 2s, the three expressions give (0,0,5), (0,5,5) and (5,5,0) V, matching the plotted plateaus. Jump sizes are +5, +5 and −5V. The graph does not specify point values at the jumps; use one consistent ϵ(0) convention. All three expressions match answer 5-31 on printed p. 336 and PDF p. 345.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第186页／PDF第195页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 186 · PDF p. 195. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：7-6Assigned requirement: 7-6

有效值相量：先统一余弦形式，再除以√2RMS phasors: convert to cosine, then divide by √2

题目原文Transcribed question

写出下列正弦量的有效值相量。 (1)u1(t)=cosωt；(2)u2(t)=−sinωt；(3)u3(t)=−cosωt；(4)u4(t)=sinωt。Write the RMS phasors of the following sinusoidal quantities: (1)u1(t)=cosωt; (2)u2(t)=−sinωt; (3)u3(t)=−cosωt; (4)u4(t)=sinωt.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

余弦基准有效值相量；正弦与余弦相差90°；负号等价于180°相移。Cosine-reference RMS phasors, the 90° sine and cosine shift and the 180° phase reversal for a negative sign.
本书采用余弦基准。每个波形幅值为1，故有效值均为12。相量的相角必须从化为正幅值余弦后的初相角读取。The book uses a cosine reference. All amplitudes are 1, so every RMS magnitude is 12. Read the phase after converting to a positive-amplitude cosine.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

统一变换规则Use one consistent conversion rule

若u=Umcos(ωt+ϕ)，有效值相量为(Um2)∠ϕ。不要把相量幅值仍写成原波形的峰值。For u=Umcos(ωt+ϕ), the RMS phasor is (Um2)∠ϕ. Do not retain the waveform’s peak magnitude in an RMS phasor.

u=Umcos(ωt+φ) ⟺ U˙=Um2∠φ

(1)、(3)处理余弦及负号(1), (3): cosine and its negative

cosωt的相角为0°；−cosωt=cos(ωt+180°)。负号进入相角，有效值大小保持非负。cosωt has phase 0°. Also −cosωt=cos(ωt+180°). Move the negative sign into the phase and keep the RMS magnitude nonnegative.

U˙1=12∠0∘,U˙3=12∠180∘

(2)、(4)处理正弦(2), (4): sine waveforms

−sinωt=cos(ωt+90°)，sinωt=cos(ωt−90°)。所以负正弦对应+90°，正正弦对应−90°。−sinωt=cos(ωt+90°) and sinωt=cos(ωt−90°). Thus negative sine gives +90° and positive sine gives −90°.

U˙2=12∠90∘,U˙4=12∠(−90∘)

(1)(12)∠0°V；(2)(12)∠90°V；(3)(12)∠180°V；(4)(12)∠−90°V。12≈0.707。(1)(12)∠0°V; (2)(12)∠90°V; (3)(12)∠180°V; (4)(12)∠−90°V, with 12≈0.707.

易错点Common errors

  • 使用余弦基准时sinωt对应−90°，不是+90°。Under a cosine reference, sinωt has phase −90°, not +90°.
  • 有效值相量的模为12，不是1。An RMS phasor has magnitude 12 here, not 1.

核验依据Verification

独立逆变换核验：将四个相量分别代入u(t)=2Re{U˙eʲωt}，还原为cosωt、−sinωt、−cosωt、sinωt；多组时间点数值核验相符。各相量模平方均为12，与单位幅值正弦波的周期均方值相同。书第337页、PDF346页7-6给出的0.707及四个相角一致。Independent inverse-transform check: u(t)=2ReU˙ejωt reconstructs cosωt, −sinωt, −cosωt and sinωt. Numerical checks at multiple times agree. Every squared magnitude is 12, the cycle mean-square value of a unit-amplitude sinusoid. The 0.707 magnitudes and all four angles match answer 7-6 on printed p. 337 and PDF p. 346.

7-12指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第187页／PDF第196页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：7-12Assigned requirement: 7-12

并联RC电流正交：有效值用勾股关系Orthogonal parallel−RC currents: use the RMS right triangle

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-6所示正弦交流电路中，已知I=10A，I2=6A，求电流I1。For the sinusoidal circuit in Fig. 7-6, I=10A and I2=6A are RMS magnitudes. Find I1.

输入电流I向右，经串联jωL后进入并联电容与电阻R。电容阻抗−j(ωC)，支路电流I1向下；电阻支路电流I2向下。下方为公共返回线。Input current I goes right through series jωL, then splits into parallel capacitor and resistor R. The capacitor impedance is −j(ωC), with I1 downward. The resistor branch has I2 downward. The bottom is the common return.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

相量KCL；并联共电压；电容电流超前电压90°，电阻电流同相。Phasor KCL, common parallel voltage, capacitor current leading by 90° and in-phase resistor current.
电容支路和电阻支路共有电压，两个电流相差90°。因此10A不是两个支路有效值的算术和，必须对正交相量求模。The capacitor and resistor share a voltage, so their currents are 90° apart. The 10A total is not the arithmetic sum of branch RMS magnitudes; take the magnitude of orthogonal phasors.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

选择方便的相位基准Choose a convenient phase reference

取并联两端电压为0°基准。电阻电流I2=6∠0°A，电容电流I1=jI1。上游串联电感不改变这两个并联支路电流之间的90°关系。Choose the parallel voltage as the 0° reference. The resistor current is 6∠0°A and capacitor current is jI1. The upstream series inductor does not change the 90° relation between the two parallel currents.

I˙2=6,I˙1=jI1,I˙=6+jI1

用总电流的模求支路有效值Use the total magnitude to recover the branch RMS value

相量实部、虚部正交，所以总电流有效值平方为两支路平方和。Real and imaginary components are orthogonal, so the squared total RMS magnitude is the sum of the squared branch magnitudes.

102=62+I12⇒I1=100−36=8A

区分相对相角与绝对相角Distinguish relative and absolute phase

在所选并联电压基准下，可写I˙1=j8A、I˙=6+j8A。题目未提供全电路的绝对相位，确定的数值答案是I1的有效值8A。Relative to the chosen parallel-voltage reference, I˙1=j8A and I˙=6+j8A. The problem gives no overall absolute phase; the determined numerical answer is the RMS magnitude I1=8A.

I˙=10∠53.13∘(relative to the parallel voltage)

I1=8A（有效值）。取并联电压为0°时，I˙1=8∠90°A。I1=8A RMS. With parallel voltage chosen as 0°, I˙1=8∠90°A.

易错点Common errors

  • 不能写I1=10−6=4A；只有相量而非模满足直接相加。Do not write I1=10−6=4A; phasors, not their magnitudes, add directly.
  • 题目未给绝对相位，不能把自选参考角当作已知绝对相角。Do not present a chosen reference phase as an externally given absolute phase.

核验依据Verification

独立复数核验：6+j8的模为√(36+64)=10，电阻与电容电流的均方交叉项2Re6·(j8)*=0，所以总均方值为100A2。相量KCL与周期均方关系独立吻合。书第337页、PDF346页7-12为8A。Independent complex check: |6+j8|=36+64=10. The RMS cross term is 2Re6·(j8)*=0, so the total mean square is 100A2. Phasor KCL and the cycle mean-square relation agree independently. Answer 7-12 on printed p. 337 and PDF p. 346 is 8A.

7-17指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第187页／PDF第196页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 187 · PDF p. 196. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：7-17Assigned requirement: 7-17

串联未知元件：相量相减后求阻抗An unknown series element: subtract phasor voltages, then divide

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-11所示正弦交流电路中，已知U˙=10∠53.1°V，U˙1=6∠0°V，求I˙、U˙2及未知元件的复阻抗Z2，并说明该元件是什么元件。For the sinusoidal circuit in Fig. 7-11, U˙=10∠53.1°V and U˙1=6∠0°V. Find I˙, U˙2 and the unknown element impedance Z2, and identify the element.

左电压源U˙上正下负，串联上方3Ω电阻与右侧Z2。电流I˙顺时针；电阻电压U˙1左正右负，Z2电压U˙2上正下负，均为关联参考方向。The left source U˙ is positive at the top and drives series upper 3Ω and right Z2. Current I˙ is clockwise. U˙1 across 3Ω is positive on the left; U˙2 across Z2 is positive at the top. Both use passive references.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

有效值相量；串联KVL；矩形式复数相减；阻抗虚部判别。RMS phasors, series KVL, rectangular complex subtraction and impedance classification by reactance.
电阻电压先给出电流相量。再把总电压化为矩形式与6V相减，最后除以电流。给定53.1°是6−8−10三角形角度53.130…°的一位小数近似。The resistor voltage directly gives the current phasor. Convert total voltage to rectangular form, subtract 6V, then divide by the current. The given 53.1° is the one-decimal approximation to the 6−8−10 triangle angle 53.130…°.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由电阻电压求电流Find current from the resistor voltage

3Ω为纯电阻，电流与U˙1同相，大小为63。The 3Ω resistor gives current in phase with U˙1 and magnitude 63.

I˙=U˙13=2∠0∘A

矩形式做KVL相减Use rectangular KVL subtraction

按题目相角精度，10∠53.1°≈6+j8V。因此U˙2≈(6+j8)−6=j8V；不是10−6=4V。To the precision of the given angle, 10∠53.1°≈6+j8V. Thus U˙2≈(6+j8)−6=j8V, not the scalar difference 10−6=4V.

U˙2=U˙−U˙1≈j8=8∠90∘V

求阻抗并识别元件Find impedance and identify the element

U˙2除以I˙得到正的纯虚阻抗，按本题精度为电感元件，感抗ωL≈4Ω；题目未给ω，不能单独求L数值。Dividing U˙2 by I˙ gives a positive imaginary impedance. To the problem’s precision it is an inductor with ωL≈4Ω. No numerical L can be found without ω.

Z2=U˙2I˙≈j4Ω,L≈4ωH

保留题目角度舍入的含义Respect the rounded input angle

若把53.1°当作完全精确数，计算得到U˙2≈0.004202+j7.996847V，Z2≈0.002101+j3.998423Ω。其极小实部来自给定角度舍入；教材标准答案j4Ω对应理想6−8−10关系。If 53.1° is treated as mathematically exact, U˙2≈0.004202+j7.996847V and Z2≈0.002101+j3.998423Ω. The tiny real part results from the rounded input angle; the textbook j4Ω answer uses the ideal 6−8−10 relation.

I˙=2∠0°A；U˙2≈8∠90°V；Z2≈j4Ω，为电感元件（按题目相角精度）。I˙=2∠0°A; U˙2≈8∠90°V; Z2≈j4Ω, an inductor to the stated phase precision.

易错点Common errors

  • 相量减法应先化矩形式，不能直接相减电压有效值。Convert to rectangular form for subtraction; do not subtract RMS magnitudes directly.
  • 纯虚阻抗j4Ω不等于电感4H；还需角频率。Reactance j4Ω does not mean an inductance of 4H; angular frequency is also required.

核验依据Verification

独立回代：I˙(3+j4)=2(3+j4)=6+j8，其模为10V、相角arctan(86)=53.130102…°，按一位小数正好53.1°。复功率为U˙I˙*=12+j16VA，3Ω消耗12W，电感吸收无功16var，功率一致。同时保留按53.1°字面计算的微小实部以避免伪称完全精确。书第337页、PDF346页7-17的2∠0°、8∠90°、j4Ω与此精度解释一致。Independent substitution: I˙(3+j4)=2(3+j4)=6+j8, with magnitude 10V and angle arctan(86)=53.130102…°, rounding to 53.1°. Complex power is U˙I˙*=12+j16VA: 3Ω consumes 12W and the inductor absorbs 16var. The tiny real part obtained from a literal 53.1° calculation is retained explicitly rather than claiming exact equality. Answer 7-17 on printed p. 337 and PDF p. 346 gives 2∠0°, 8∠90° and j4Ω, consistent with this precision.

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第188页／PDF第197页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：7-23Assigned requirement: 7-23

零支路电流不等于右侧无电流：并联无功相抵Zero branch current can coexist with circulating reactive currents

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-17所示正弦交流电路中，已知ω=100 rads，I˙=0，求I˙L1、I˙C和C的值。For the sinusoidal circuit in Fig. 7-17, ω=100 rads and I˙=0. Find I˙L1, I˙C and C.

100∠0°V源上正下负，顶端经100Ω到节点A；A经j100Ω到地，IL1向下；A经200Ω到节点B，该支路I向右。B经j500Ω及电容阻抗−j(ωC)两支路到地，IL2和IC均向下。A top-positive 100∠0°V source connects through 100Ω to A. A connects through j100Ω to ground, with IL1 downward. A200Ω resistor joins A to B, carrying I rightward. B connects through parallel j500Ω and −j(ωC) branches to ground, with IL2 and IC downward.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

相量KCL、KVL；零电阻支路电流意味着两端等电位；并联LC导纳相消。Phasor KCL and KVL, equal potentials across a resistor with zero current and cancellation of parallel LC admittances.
I˙=0使200Ω压降为0，故A、B电压相同。右侧电感和电容电流不必分别为0，只需大小相等、方向相反的相量相加为0。I˙=0 makes the 200Ω voltage drop zero, so A and B have equal voltage. The right inductor and capacitor currents need not vanish individually; equal and opposite phasors can sum to zero.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

由零电流确定右侧导纳Use zero current to determine the right-side admittance

B点KCL为I˙L2+I˙C=0。B电压非0，因此并联导纳必须为0，电容容抗大小等于500Ω。KCL at B is I˙L2+I˙C=0. Since B’s voltage is nonzero, the parallel admittance must vanish; capacitive reactance magnitude is 500Ω.

1j500+jωC=0⇒C=1500ω=150000F=20μF

计算左电感电流Calculate the left inductor current

右侧不取净电流，左源只驱动100Ω与j100Ω串联，所以电流就是I˙L1。The right side draws zero net current, so the source drives series 100Ω and j100Ω; their current is I˙L1.

I˙L1=100100+j100=12−j12=22∠(−45∘)A

求公共节点电压与电容电流Find common voltage and capacitor current

A、B电压均为j100I˙L1=50+j50V。电容阻抗−j500Ω，因此I˙C=U˙B(−j500)。A and B are both at j100I˙L1=50+j50V. The capacitor impedance is −j500Ω, so I˙C=U˙B(−j500).

U˙A=U˙B=50+j50,I˙C=−0.1+j0.1=210∠135∘A

I˙L1=(22)∠−45°A；I˙C=(210)∠135°A；C=20μF。I˙L1=(22)∠−45°A; I˙C=(210)∠135°A; C=20μF.

易错点Common errors

  • I˙=0不意味着I˙L2=I˙C=0；它们相量相消。I˙=0 does not imply I˙L2=I˙C=0; their phasors cancel.
  • 电容电流是电压除以−jX，即相位超前90°。Dividing by capacitive −jX makes current lead voltage by 90°.

核验依据Verification

独立完整双节点方程求解（保留200Ω支路）得到A=B=50+j50V，故200Ω电流严格为0；I˙L2=0.1−j0.1A，恰与I˙C相反。复功率核验：100Ω耗散50W；左电感+50var，右电感+10var，电容−10var；源提供50+j50VA，总和为0。书第337页、PDF346页7-23的两个相量与20μF均一致。An independent full two-node solve, retaining the 200Ω branch, gives A=B=50+j50V and zero 200Ω current. I˙L2=0.1−j0.1A exactly cancels I˙C. Complex-power check: 100Ω dissipates 50W; the left and right inductors absorb +50 and +10var, and the capacitor −10var. The source supplies 50+j50VA, balancing all loads. Both phasors and 20μF match answer 7-23 on printed p. 337 and PDF p. 346.

7-24指定作业Assigned已抄题并核验解析Transcribed & solution checked

来源：电路分析基础，第3版，俎云霄等 · 书第188页／PDF第197页。范围状态：指定作业（指定小问优先）。Source: Fundamentals of Circuit Analysis, 3rd ed. · printed p. 188 · PDF p. 197. Coverage: assigned exercise; stated subparts take priority.

指定要求：7-24Assigned requirement: 7-24

跨节点电压源：用超节点KCL反求源相量A voltage source between nodes: recover its phasor with supernode KCL

题目原文Transcribed question

题图7-18所示正弦交流电路中，已知U˙1=4∠0°V，试求U˙s。For the sinusoidal circuit in Fig. 7-18, U˙1=4∠0°V. Find U˙s.

底部公共节点。左中节点A经2Ω接地，电压U1上正下负；A还经−j1Ω电容、再经左侧1Ω接地。A到右中节点B之间有电压源Us，左负右正。B经−j1Ω电容接地，并经顶端j1Ω、再经右侧2Ω串联接地。The bottom is common. Left-middle A connects through 2Ω to ground, with U1 positive at A. Another A−to-ground path contains −j1Ω then left 1Ω. Voltage source Us lies between A and right-middle B, negative at A and positive at B. B connects to ground through −j1Ω, and through upper j1Ω in series with right 2Ω.

先想：怎么识别与起步Hint: recognition and first step

前置知识Prerequisites

相量节点法；电压源超节点；复数导纳；源电压极性。Phasor nodal analysis, voltage-source supernodes, complex admittances and source polarity.
U˙1已给出A=4V。把A、B及它们之间的电压源看成超节点，直接对所有向地支路列KCL，避开未知源电流；最后按右正左负求Us=B−A。U˙1 fixes A=4V. Treat A, B and their intervening voltage source as a supernode, summing all currents to ground without the unknown source current. Finally use the right-positive polarity: Us=B−A.
完整解析与结果核验Full solution & verification

把两边支路写成导纳Write each side’s admittance

A对地有2Ω及(1−j)Ω两条支路；B对地有−jΩ及(2+j)Ω两条支路。各串联路径之间没有分叉，可先相加阻抗。A has paths of 2Ω and (1−j)Ω to ground. B has paths of −jΩ and (2+j)Ω. Each series path has no intermediate branch, so its impedances add.

YA=12+11−j=1+j2,YB=1−j+12+j=25+j45

对超节点列KCLApply supernode KCL

没有电流源向超节点外部注入，全部向地电流相加为0。A=4∠0°=4V，于是可直接解B电位。No current source injects from outside the supernode. Sum all ground-directed currents to zero and use A=4V to solve B.

YAU˙A+YBU˙B=0⇒U˙B=−4+j20.4+j0.8=−4+j3(V)

按源极性计算UsCalculate Us with its stated polarity

图中Us右正左负，源电压是B相对A的电压，不能反过来相减。Us is positive on the right and negative on the left, so it is B relative to A, not the reverse.

U˙s=U˙B−U˙A=(−4+j3)−4=−8+j3V

U˙s=−8+j3V（图示右正左负）。U˙s=−8+j3V, positive on the right as drawn.

易错点Common errors

  • B电位−4+j3V还不是所求源电压；还需减去A=4V。B’s potential −4+j3V is not the source voltage; subtract A=4V.
  • 电容阻抗−j的导纳为+j，不能漏掉符号变化。The admittance of capacitive impedance −j is +j; retain this sign change.

核验依据Verification

独立完整MNA：将−8+j3V源接回原电路，解得A=4V、B=−4+j3V，左最外节点2+j2V、右最外节点−2+j4V，确实重现题设。源正端流入电流4+j2A，吸收复功率(−8+j3)(4−j2)=−26+j28VA；三只电阻共耗散26W，电感与两只电容净无功−28var，总复功率为0。书第337页、PDF346页7-24为−8+j3V。Independent full MNA: restoring the −8+j3V source to the original circuit gives A=4V and B=−4+j3V, with outer-left node 2+j2V and outer-right node −2+j4V, reproducing the given voltage. Current entering the source’s positive terminal is 4+j2A, so its absorbed complex power is (−8+j3)(4−j2)=−26+j28VA. The three resistors dissipate 26W and the inductor and capacitors have net reactive power −28var, giving zero total complex power. Answer 7-24 on printed p. 337 and PDF p. 346 is −8+j3V.
